channel.description: 模型压缩、机器学习编译、高性能计算、边缘计算、低功耗计算方向的最新论文、文章与技术报告的全量检索推送（arXiv / 顶会 / 技术博客）。软分类：论文PDF / 技术博客 / 官方公告 / 每日精选。

item.title: Day-0 Support for Flint on vLLM
item.description:
发表方：vLLM Blog　发布：2026-10-21　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 新 MoE 模型 Recursive Flint（40B 参数、每 token 激活约 2.5B、262K 上下文、滑动窗口注意力）如何在 vLLM 上拿到 Day-0 支持并做到高效解码。

要点 vLLM 从发布第一天支持 Flint：NVFP4 与 BF16 两个 checkpoint 均可单 GPU 运行；架构上 35 层滑动窗口（513 token）+14 层全上下文（仅这 14 层保留全序列 KV，缓存 28 KiB/token）、256 专家 sigmoid top-6+共享专家；NVFP4 为 GGUF 封装、加载时无损重打包，以 W4A16 权重仅权重模式运行，各 kernel 对齐参考实现舍入点；逐项替换小批量 kernel（融合 Q/K norm+RoPE+KV 写、小批量 MoE GEMV、低时延解码路径等）。

关键数字 单请求 GB200 上约 500 token/s（100K 上下文）；NVFP4 decode 4.81→1.78 ms（2.7×）、BF16 3.53→2.34 ms（1.5×）、8K prefill 207→145 ms（1.4×），前向 kernel 数 1096→346；端到端 batch-1 100K 上下文 2.06 ms/token（约 485 token/s）。

为什么值得看 展示新 MoE 模型从"能跑"到"跑得快"的完整 kernel 优化路径，对长上下文+滑动窗口架构的推理调优有直接借鉴。

item.title: Announcing Humming: Fast, Flexible Kernels for Quantized Inference
item.description:
发表方：vLLM Blog　发布：2026-10-21　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 量化推理 kernel 开发维护成本随模型与 GPU 代际组合爆炸——每新增量化格式/后端都要专属 kernel、预处理、适配与测试，vLLM 生态需要一种通用、高性能的量化 kernel 库。

要点 Ant Group 与 vLLM 社区开源 Humming：把量化描述与执行选择分离、kernel 由共享组件组合而成；统一量化表示转换各工具导出格式，支持 Turing 以来 NVIDIA GPU 与 CUDA 兼容设备（如 T-Head Zhenwu 810E），覆盖稠密与 MoE 的各类权重/激活格式组合（WNA16/W8A8/W4A8/W4A4 与 INT4/NVFP4 等）。

关键数字 支持 NVIDIA Turing 起全系 GPU；覆盖多种整数/浮点类型、位宽与缩放方案组合；在多个代表性负载上显著优于 vLLM Marlin、FlashInfer、DeepGEMM 现有实现。

为什么值得看 把"为每种组合写 kernel"的维护负担降为"描述+组件组合"，是量化推理基础设施的一次范式简化，仓库已开源。

item.title: ZKPU: Zero-Knowledge Processing Unit for Heterogeneous Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) have become a fundamental building block for privacy-preserving computation, blockchain systems, and verifiable machine learning.

Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) have become a fundamental building block for privacy-preserving computation, blockchain systems, and verifiable machine learning. Modern ZKP protocols span two distinct families: curve-based protocols, which rely on large finite-field arithmetic, and hash-based protocols, which operate over native 64-bit fields. Existing hardware accelerators are specialized for one protocol family because they are built on operand-scanning Montgomery multiplication, resulting in fixed-width datapaths, poor utilization across heterogeneous operand widths, and limited scalability. This paper presents \emph{ZKPU}, a Zero-Knowledge Processing Unit for heterogeneous ZKP workloads. ZKPU introduces a new compute paradigm by co-designing finely integrated product scanning (FIPS) Montgomery multiplication with a reconfigurable Twin Systolic Fabric (TSF), enabling modular multiplication at arbitrary widths in 64-bit increments. Combined with a fine-grained Deque buffer, on-chip twiddle-factor generator, and memory-efficient MSM preprocessing strategy, ZKPU provides a unified architecture for both curve-based and hash-based protocols. Evaluation using Groth16 and Plonky2 shows th…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When Do LLMs Help with Feature Selection? A Systematic Empirical Study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) can leverage semantic feature names alongside summary statistics for tabular feature selection, yet it remains unclear when such information improves subset selection relative to established statistical methods.

Large language models (LLMs) can leverage semantic feature names alongside summary statistics for tabular feature selection, yet it remains unclear when such information improves subset selection relative to established statistical methods. We investigate this question within an 18-dataset framework comprising 10 datasets for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) training, 2 for checkpoint validation, and 6 held-out evaluation datasets. We compare five classical baselines, frozen Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.3-70B selectors, and two GRPO-adapted Qwen2.5-7B models, reporting classification ROC-AUC and regression R^2 separately and using dataset-wise ranks for cross-task comparison. Across five seeded evaluation partitions, classical selectors generally achieve higher predictive performance than the tested 7B LLM/RL selectors, including under a pre-specified ~33% feature budget with strict train-only classical fitting, while the 7B selectors retain compact subsets. A cardinality-matched semantic sensitivity experiment shows that, for Zero-shot Qwen-7B, informative feature names improve regression performance over anonymized and shuffled alternatives (+0.1964 and +0.1606 mean R^2), wher…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Weight Placement Is Not Enough: Synchronization in Multi-Node CPU Decoding of Ternary LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 三值 LLM 每解码 token 只读几 GB，但四 NUMA 节点双路服务器上最快三值运行时只用不到一半内存带宽——把权重放在读取它的线程所在节点就够了吗？

方法 构建节点局部权重、复用 ik_llama kernel 的解码引擎，用逐线程 barrier 追踪定位等待来源；比较 Megatron 风格列切分与行切分（无跨节点归约），并隔离 barrier 数量效应。

关键数字 两代 Xeon 上线程每 token 有 20–48% 时间等在同步点，主要是等各节点最慢线程；列切分在全部配置下胜出；DRAM 受限解码较 ik_llama 全核快 1.5–2.1×、较其最快线程数 1.5–1.9×（L3 缓存小模型 3.2×/2.8×），同精度且每 token 能耗更低。

为什么值得看 指出多节点 CPU 三值解码的真正瓶颈在同步而非带宽，给出可复现的列切分工程答案。

item.title: Unsupervised Head Network Personalization for Split Computing via Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Split Computing (SC) is a distributed inference method designed for balancing computational load and reducing latency by partitioning a neural network into head and tail networks and deploying them across both a mobile device and a server, respectively.

Split Computing (SC) is a distributed inference method designed for balancing computational load and reducing latency by partitioning a neural network into head and tail networks and deploying them across both a mobile device and a server, respectively. Due to the limited bandwidth and computational power of mobile devices, the head network is often replaced with a neural network that requires lower computational and communication resources. However, it is challenging to prepare a sufficient quantity and quality of labeled data on the mobile device side for training the replacement head network. Furthermore, the data prepared by mobile users often contains sensitive privacy information, making data aggregation difficult. In this paper, we propose a data-efficient head network training method for SC. This method utilizes federated learning and knowledge distillation to train the head network using a small amount of non-IID and unlabeled data from mobile devices, ensuring that the training datasets are not exposed. Moreover, by introducing personalization, we enhance the accuracy to levels comparable to or exceeding those of existing methods. The experimental evaluations demonstrate …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Two Is Enough: Binary Classification Priors Suffice for Multi-Class In-Context Tabular Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) pretrain a transformer on large-scale synthetic priors so that a single forward pass yields zero-shot tabular prediction.

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) pretrain a transformer on large-scale synthetic priors so that a single forward pass yields zero-shot tabular prediction. TabICLv2 samples the class count of its classification prior during pretraining, and the prevailing configuration caps it at ten. We report a counter-intuitive result: setting this cap directly to two---making every pretrained classification task binary---still yields weights that perform zero-shot K-way classification 2. On the 38 TabArena classification datasets (200 bootstrap rounds, anchored at default RF = 1000), the binary two-stage recipe reaches 1590.1 Elo, above the official default at 1568.0 (+22.1), above TabPFN-v2.6 (1577.1) and RealTabPFN-v2.5 (1521.6). A production-scale validation on 60 real-world credit-scoring institutions independently confirms the direction: the same checkpoint improves test AUC on 44 of 60 institutions (paired Wilcoxon p = 0.0007 for AUC, p = 0.0002 for KS) at +1.5 inference cost. Mechanistically, classification in TabICLv2 is carried not by a fixed-cardinality output head but by an in-context comparison operator matching query-row embeddings against class-conditional embeddings, so the cardin…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Training-Free Continual Learning for Multimodal Forecasting via Prompt Evolution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Adapting a forecasting system to a changing world classically means retraining.

Adapting a forecasting system to a changing world classically means retraining. We ask whether the task of continually learning regimes for time series forecasting can be represented by a piece of text: a guidance block, evolved by outcome-driven reflection and used in a frozen LLM forecaster's prompt. On a refreshed multimodal benchmark (weekly search indices, daily currencies, daily commodities, each window paired with web-retrieved news), we run GEPA-style prompt evolution under strict contamination control to prevent the data leakage common in timeseries benchmarks: the forecaster's knowledge cutoff predates every evaluated window. A 900-word evolved guidance carried by Llama-3.3-70B beats TimeSeries Foundation Models (TSFMs) on held-out data (GM MASE 0.776 vs. 0.898 for TabPFN-TS-3), transfers to more recent models without measurable loss, and costs dollars rather than GPU-days to update. We characterize the loop: out-of-loop gains concentrate in the first reflection, in-loop improvements overstate out-of-loop gains 2-3x unless an untouched monitor arbitrates, and error-only objectives silently suppress the text modality. We provide two extensions. First, compiling the guidanc…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Timing-Aware and Interpretable Self-Attention for Event-Based Wearable Task Transition Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Task transition detection aims to identify when a person shifts from one task to another, providing a foundation for continuous health monitoring and timely context-aware interventions.

Task transition detection aims to identify when a person shifts from one task to another, providing a foundation for continuous health monitoring and timely context-aware interventions. While statistical and deep feature representations have demonstrated strong classification performance, they often rely on aggregated or latent features that are difficult to interpret in behavioural terms. Event-based features provide a compact and interpretable alternative by encoding behavioural and physiological patterns as discrete tokens with explicit semantic meaning, making them well suited for behavioural analysis in health informatics. Self-attention offers a mechanism for modelling interactions among such tokens; however, conventional self-attention classifiers primarily rely on token order and do not explicitly incorporate timing or duration information. As a result, informative temporal cues in event representations may not be fully exploited for task transition detection. This study proposes an event-based time-aware self-attention framework that represents behavioural signals as sequences of discrete events augmented with onset timestamps and durations. Event timing is encoded using a…

item.title: The Token-Energy Law of LLM Decode: Active Bytes and Realized Time Account for Joules per Token
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 高效部署 LLM 需要理解模型架构、硬件与服务设置如何共同塑造每生成 token 的能耗——能否给出一个紧凑、可解释的每 token 能耗模型？

方法 提出 Token-Energy Law：GPU 板级每输出 token 能耗由两个核心维度决定——活跃字节（单次解码迭代内共享的稠密权重 + 每请求读写的私有 KV 历史）与实现解码时间（解码时长/输出 token 数）；两者与时间合成仿射形式，系数按模型与硬件/运行时配置校准。

关键数字 三模型 BF16 解码、NVIDIA Hopper 与 Blackwell GPU（含 Hopper 双卡张量并行）实测；固定系数+观测解码时间下，留出条件均值能耗估计与实测最大偏差 3.73%。

为什么值得看 一个定律统一解释 batch 摊销共享权重、长上下文推高私有 KV 需求、吞吐决定时间成本，能耗建模可直接复用。
item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 高效部署 LLM 需要理解模型架构、硬件与服务设置如何共同塑造每生成 token 的能耗——能否给出一个紧凑、可解释的每 token 能耗模型？

方法 提出 Token-Energy Law：GPU 板级每输出 token 能耗由两个核心维度决定——活跃字节（单次解码迭代内共享的稠密权重 + 每请求读写的私有 KV 历史）与实现解码时间（解码时长/输出 token 数）；两者与时间合成仿射形式，系数按模型与硬件/运行时配置校准。

关键数字 三模型 BF16 解码、NVIDIA Hopper 与 Blackwell GPU（含 Hopper 双卡张量并行）实测；固定系数+观测解码时间下，留出条件均值能耗估计与实测最大偏差 3.73%。

为什么值得看 一个定律统一解释 batch 摊销共享权重、长上下文推高私有 KV 需求、吞吐决定时间成本，能耗建模可直接复用。

item.title: The Optimal Ranking Tradeoffs Between Two Ranking Scores in Two-Class Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

The accuracy, true negative rate (negative class recall), true positive rate (positive class recall), negative predictive value (negative class precision), positive predictive value (positive class pr

The accuracy, true negative rate (negative class recall), true positive rate (positive class recall), negative predictive value (negative class precision), positive predictive value (positive class precision), class-specific intersections over unions, class-specific F-scores, Cohen's kappa, and balanced accuracy are scores that one intuitively wants to maximize when developing machine learning methods. However, they lead to different rankings of such methods. So, how can we establish a ranking that is an optimal tradeoff between any pair of these scores? It turns out that all these scores are special cases of ranking scores: a continuum of scores parameterized by the relative importance values assigned to the true negative, false positive, false negative, and true positive outcomes. Since all these scores are known to induce meaningful rankings, we seek the optimal tradeoffs among them. We consider the tradeoff between two scores to be optimal when it minimizes the Fréchet variance regarding the Kendall distance (also known as the bubble-sort distance) between rankings. For any given set of classifiers to rank, the optimal tradeoff lies at the center of the shortest (geodesic) path…

item.title: The Dynamics of Collapse and Recovery in Clustered Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Clustered federated learning (CFL) can suffer from cluster collapse.

Clustered federated learning (CFL) can suffer from cluster collapse. In particular, under unfavorable initialization, early client assignments concentrate heterogeneous groups on one cluster model, which is then trained toward a pooled compromise, while another model receives no updates. Since the current models determine client routing and routing determines subsequent model updates, we formulate clustered federated learning as control of an unknown dynamical system, with cluster models as the evolving state, client routing patterns as the control input, and routing interventions as state dependent controllers. In a two group linear model, we identify an initialization region in which greedy routing makes collapse self reinforcing. We then derive finite horizon error dynamics showing how routing interventions can reverse collapse by repeatedly training the starved model, primarily with updates from its compatible group. Motivated by this condition, each client uses blocked EXP3 to choose between greedy routing and interventions that redirect updates toward unused models. Experiments show that with simpler predictors and faster specialist formation, autonomous controller selection …

item.title: SliMOO: Interpretable Multi-Objective Evolutionary Search for LLM Depth Pruning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 深度剪枝直接降低内存与延迟，但 transformer 层对任务贡献高度异质，现有方法忽略异质性、易窄化到单一领域——剪枝是否应建模为多目标优化？

方法 SliMOO 可解释多目标进化搜索：先做单层移除探测构建任务-层重要性图（可解释视图，作为搜索先验），再做 Pareto 感知进化搜索剪枝掩码，候选按任务层先验引导生成、按各任务相对稠密模型的偏差打分，经 NSGA-II 环境选择保留。

关键数字 Llama-3.1 与 Qwen3 家族上多任务权衡一致强于规则/贪心/标量化基线；Llama-3.1-70B 25% 稀疏度下数学域均值从 24.33% 提到 34.40%、代码域从 35.03% 提到 39.14%。

为什么值得看 把深度剪枝从单分数排序升级为可解释多目标进化搜索，兼顾任务共享层与特异层，代码将开源。

item.title: Self-Evolving Agents through Privileged Retrospective Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Self-evolving agents aim to improve from their own experience rather than remain fixed after deployment, but naturally collected trajectories often lack ground-truth solutions or verifier-derived rewards.

Self-evolving agents aim to improve from their own experience rather than remain fixed after deployment, but naturally collected trajectories often lack ground-truth solutions or verifier-derived rewards. We introduce Retrospective Self-Distillation (RSD), a multi-round framework that turns such experience into dense supervision using privileged retrospective context. For each on-policy trajectory, the same underlying model acts as both student and teacher: the teacher re-scores the student's realized actions while conditioning on cross-task precedents and lessons, together with turn-level reflection and future hindsight from the completed trajectory. The resulting teacher distribution is distilled back into the policy through on-policy self-distillation. Across rounds, the experience bank grows and the retrospective context is refreshed, allowing the model, its data, and its supervision to co-evolve. We further introduce frontier-guided context-policy evolution, where a stronger frontier model proposes constrained edits to how privileged context is constructed. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SearchQA with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B, RSD improves performance by up to 59.7% relative…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Scaling Graph Reasoning in Language Models with Learnable Graph Positional Encodings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Solving reasoning tasks supported on graphs typically requires providing a Language Reasoning Model (LRM) with a serialized description of the graph.

Solving reasoning tasks supported on graphs typically requires providing a Language Reasoning Model (LRM) with a serialized description of the graph. This approach results in the input length growing with the number of edges, which limits the size of the problems that can be solved. Furthermore, even when graphs fit in context, performance sharply decays as the graphs grow. We propose to address this by augmenting LRMs with scalable and permutation equivariant graph positional encodings that modulate attention logits. An additional post-fusion-style module incorporates structural information into hidden states. We compute these positional encodings using a GNN followed by a Graph Transformer. This eliminates the need for serialized adjacencies, reducing the context burden to $O(N)$. We jointly fine-tune the positional encoder and the LRM LoRA adapters using optimal solutions generated by graph-theoretic solvers, resulting in a computationally efficient method. Trained on small graphs, the model exhibits improved size-generalization across graph-theoretic tasks on graphs with up to 1,000 nodes, and produces fewer tokens than a conventional LRM. Additionally, we observe that our mode…

item.title: Relative Representations Enable Portable White-Box Monitoring Across Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Independently trained autoregressive language models often acquire similar capabilities, but it remains unclear whether their internal representations organize behaviorally relevant information in compatible ways.

Independently trained autoregressive language models often acquire similar capabilities, but it remains unclear whether their internal representations organize behaviorally relevant information in compatible ways. We show that models do in fact organize information similarly by using specific behavioral probes that operate on compatible representations. This unlocks portable white-box monitoring: a probe developed and validated on one model can be reused when the model changes, without requiring labeled target data. To overcome incompatible native activation coordinates, we express each example through its angular distances to a shared set of anchors. We introduce a global anchored construction that summarizes information from all transformer layers and removes model-specific layer selection, so the same frozen probe can be straightforwardly applied to another model. We evaluate cross-model probe transfer across monitoring tasks on trivia datasets, safety monitoring, and mathematical reasoning. On average, transferred global anchored probes preserve at least 85% of same-model probe AUROC over chance. Anchored probes also support transfer to related datasets, remain robust across mo…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:

Floorplanning with rectilinear soft modules improves area utilization and wirelength by allowing modules to adapt to rectilinear polygon (RPoly) shapes.

Floorplanning with rectilinear soft modules improves area utilization and wirelength by allowing modules to adapt to rectilinear polygon (RPoly) shapes. Existing methods typically construct rectilinear polygons through incremental refinement after obtaining a rectangular global solution, which confines polygon exploration to the neighborhood induced by the initial floorplan. This paper presents RPolyPlan, a unified framework for outline-free and fixed-outline floorplanning that directly incorporates continuously deformable rectilinear polygons into global floorplanning. To enable direct polygon optimization, we introduce a structured continuous representation and a differentiable polygon shaping model that dynamically optimizes rectilinear module shapes based on overlaps, making continuous shape optimization feasible for gradient-based global floorplanning. An augmented Lagrangian formulation robustly handles the coupled inequality constraints, provides theoretical convergence guarantees, and reduces dependence on manual penalty-parameter tuning. item.title: Projected Distillation: On Learning to Solve Hard Problems from Close, Correct Targets
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities.

On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities. On hard problems, however, on-policy RL provides no reward-based learning signal when all attempts fail. On-policy distillation provides next-token supervision from a teacher, but on hard problems, if a rollout goes wrong early, subsequent supervision is conditioned on prefixes that already contain the mistake. Correct behavior can instead come from a gold or teacher solution, but such off-policy targets can differ substantially from the model's generations and, as we show, may erode existing capabilities. We therefore treat on-policyness as a continuum and propose projected distillation, which minimally edits the student's failed attempts into correct targets. The method uses contrastive updates to favor corrections over failed attempts and refreshes these corrections as the student evolves, enabling near-on-policy learning even when all student attempts fail. Theoretically, we prove that the student's learning regret grows with the edit size: it scales linearly with the horizon under minimal correction, as in DAgger, and quadrat…

item.title: Privacy Accounting for Empirical Denoisers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion models have emerged as the foundation of modern generative systems, yet their high memorization capacity raises privacy concerns.

Diffusion models have emerged as the foundation of modern generative systems, yet their high memorization capacity raises privacy concerns. While differentially private (DP) training provides formal guarantees, it comes at a cost in sample quality. In this work, we study a complementary question: how much privacy loss is incurred during the sampling process itself? Directly analyzing modern neural denoisers is challenging because their sensitivity to a single training example is generally intractable. To overcome this challenge, we construct and analyze a clipped privacy-accountable empirical denoiser, a training-free estimator of the Bayes-optimal denoiser, whose per-step sensitivity can be computed explicitly, allowing each denoising step to be a Gaussian mechanism. This perspective enables privacy accounting under Gaussian DP when each training example contributes to each denoising step, and under $f$-DP trade-off functions when each generated sample uses a single randomly subsampled block of the training data. We report every $(\varepsilon, δ)$ guarantee as a certified upper bound from a privacy loss distribution accountant, and use a cumulant-based Edgeworth approximation as a…

item.title: Peak-Memory Schedules You Can Trust: Exact Realization, Certified Optimality, and the Limits of Recomputation for Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 小设备实时推理需要低激活内存但不增加延迟——算子执行顺序是"免费的"内存杠杆，但编译器真的能做到吗？

方法： 不再信任编译器重新生成代码后能达到预测峰值，转而 profiling 已生成程序、从程序语句精确建模内存、对语句做排列搜索，证明在分配不依赖历史时总能精确兑现建模峰值。

关键数字： PyTorch Inductor 在 54 个 CPU 配置中 22 个未达预测峰值，9 个比原程序更差；GPU 上 50 个中 19 个更差且改变数值结果。

为什么值得看： 编译器不靠谱这件事在内存优化上被量化了，方法不依赖特定框架，对任何需要极致内存效率的推理部署都有参考价值。

item.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Time Series Foundation Models for Electrical Load Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Accurate electrical load forecasting supports power-system operation across countries, regions, cities, and buildings, but repeated development of target-specific models is costly.

Accurate electrical load forecasting supports power-system operation across countries, regions, cities, and buildings, but repeated development of target-specific models is costly. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide reusable pretrained backbones, although multi-domain pretraining may not fully capture load-specific characteristics. This paper compares pretrained inference, full fine-tuning, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in terms of forecasting accuracy and adaptation efficiency across four electrical load aggregation levels. MOIRAI 1.0 Large serves as the primary backbone, while Chronos-2 assesses whether the findings transfer across model families. The evaluation covers both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings and examines whether compact adaptation provides consistent gains over strong pretrained checkpoints. Pretrained foundation models outperform the implemented seasonal naive and XGBoost baselines across the evaluated aggregation levels. Accurate electrical load forecasting supports power-system operation across countries, regions, cities, and buildings, but repeated development of target-specific models is costly.

Accurate electrical load forecasting supports power-system operation across countries, regions, cities, and buildings, but repeated development of target-specific models is costly. Time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide reusable pretrained backbones, although multi-domain pretraining may not fully capture load-specific characteristics. This paper compares pretrained inference, full fine-tuning, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in terms of forecasting accuracy and adaptation efficiency across four electrical load aggregation levels. MOIRAI 1.0 Large serves as the primary backbone, while Chronos-2 assesses whether the findings transfer across model families. The evaluation covers both in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings and examines whether compact adaptation provides consistent gains over strong pretrained checkpoints. Pretrained foundation models outperform the implemented seasonal naive and XGBoost baselines across the evaluated aggregation levels. On MOIRAI Large, rank-16 LoRA reduces normalized mean absolute error (NMAE) by 7.5% on average while updating 3.146 million parameters, about 1% of the model, and retains most of the improvement from full fi…

item.title: Pairwise Learning Increases Data Efficiency in Deep Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Deep neural networks often fail at small-sample regression, collapsing to low-variance predictions that miss individual differences.

Deep neural networks often fail at small-sample regression, collapsing to low-variance predictions that miss individual differences. Here, we introduce a pairwise comparison framework that reframes regression as aggregated relative rankings. This method improves data efficiency across model architectures and dataset sizes. On the UTKFace dataset (23k images), pairwise learning generates over one billion training comparisons without additional supervision. The paired ranking allows a lightweight ResNet10 trained from scratch on home hardware to achieve a 3.64-year MAE-surpassing previous models, including those with large-scale pretraining. For classification into categories, pairwise supervision consistently outperforms an otherwise identical 10-way crossentropy model on STL10 with 500-2000 labeled examples, improving accuracy by up to 5.2%. Overall, pairwise supervision enhances data efficiency and enables strong regression and classification performance when labeled data are limited, particularly in clinical settings.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: PairSight: Characterizing and Predicting Operator-Level Interference in GPU Sharing for DNN Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： GPU 共享场景下，多个 DNN 推理任务共驻同一 GPU 时，算子级干扰到底来自哪里？能否做到既可解释又准确的慢化预测？

方法： 在 SM 分区下做算子级干扰实验，用硬件计数器追踪到共享内存路径上的争抢是关键根因；提出 PairSight，基于两算子特征联合预测慢化。

关键数字： 干扰取决于两个算子各自的内存带宽需求与计算强度组合，仅靠"算力型/内存型"二元分类远不够用。

为什么值得看： GPU 共享是降本关键手段，但粗暴的共存策略会引入不可预期的延迟抖动——这篇把干扰溯源到了可预测的算子级。

item.title: PaPi: Parallel Picard-Duhamel Integration for Fast Neuro-Spectral Architectures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Neuro-spectral architectures (NeuSA) are a class of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that have proven effective for solving time-dependent PDEs in the frequency domain.

Neuro-spectral architectures (NeuSA) are a class of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that have proven effective for solving time-dependent PDEs in the frequency domain. However, training and inference often rely on costly numerical integration of the learned vector field, typically using sequential Runge-Kutta time stepping, which limits temporal parallelism. We introduce PaPi, an integration scheme inspired by weakly nonlinear flows that enables time-Parallel inference through exponential integration and a Duhamel-Picard scheme. We show that the Duhamel-Picard iteration converges exponentially for all flows, and provide explicit error bounds that depend on how close the flow is to linear. Experiments show that PaPi accelerates training and inference by up to two orders of magnitude, achieving training times of under one second for low-dimensional PDE learning problems, while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning for Dual-Use Concepts in Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Mitigating catastrophic risks from large language models requires excising hazardous operational capabilities, such as cyberwarfare exploitation and pathogen enhancement, without degrading benign scientific utility.

Mitigating catastrophic risks from large language models requires excising hazardous operational capabilities, such as cyberwarfare exploitation and pathogen enhancement, without degrading benign scientific utility. In these dual-use domains, legitimate defensive science and malicious attacks share vocabulary, syntax, and internal model representations, causing standard unlearning methods to induce severe collateral damage (concept bleeding). In this work, we present Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning (OBU), a mathematically grounded framework designed to eliminate collateral damage on benign dual-use capabilities. OBU extracts a domain-matched capability subspace from paired calibration queries via singular value decomposition on empirical activation covariances, and restricts parameter updates strictly to the orthogonal null space. This guarantees that benign representations experience zero parameter perturbation along the spanned calibration subspace. We present two complementary realizations of OBU: Projected LoRA, which applies the orthogonal constraint during iterative gradient-based fine-tuning, and Closed-Form Weight Surgery, which directly edits model weights in a single analy…

item.title: Observation Assimilation Transformer: Probabilistic Weather Analysis from Sparse Station Observations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

We present the Observation Assimilation Transformer (OAT), a geometry-aware neural process that corrects and refines a prior numerical weather prediction (NWP) field into a high-resolution posterior field by assimilating sparse observations.

We present the Observation Assimilation Transformer (OAT), a geometry-aware neural process that corrects and refines a prior numerical weather prediction (NWP) field into a high-resolution posterior field by assimilating sparse observations. OAT is an encoder-decoder transformer that considers a set of observed locations and their NWP prior to condition predictions at a set of arbitrary unobserved query locations. Its sparse attention mechanism makes it scalable to thousands of station observations and depends on relative positions between locations, never on the absolute coordinates. The model allows for partially missing observations, predictions at arbitrary continuous locations without grid projection, and outputs are parametric distributions. A station-randomized training algorithm is developed with continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) loss. We test OAT on two datasets - one at regional scale with hundreds of stations, and one at continental scale with thousands of stations. On these datasets OAT outperforms several baselines and shows well calibrated predictions. In an illustrative case study, OAT's downscaling capabilities are demonstrated by downscaling ERA5 (~31km) t…

item.title: Near-Duplicate Image Selection Transfers Preferences in Vision-Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Subliminal learning is the phenomenon in which a model transmits its preferences to another model through data that do not explicitly express them.

Subliminal learning is the phenomenon in which a model transmits its preferences to another model through data that do not explicitly express them. As models increasingly curate training data for other models, we ask whether this transfer can arise from choosing among near-duplicate images while keeping the source photographs and human-written captions fixed. For each photograph, a curator selects one of eight near-duplicate variants by caption likelihood, without target-specific prompts. Students trained on target-preferring curators' selections show higher mean target-versus-alternatives log-likelihood ratios in an image-free readout than students trained on neutral selections. Under a prespecified decision rule, this directional shift appears for an owl target in LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL, and Gemma 4, with curators and students initialized from the same base checkpoint, and target rotations move it toward camels, oak trees, and a political figure. The owl target-selected student also scores above all count-matched random-reselection students in three models and above 55 of 60 in LLaVA-1.5, and Qwen3-VL shows the shift again on a new source bank with newly trained curators…

item.title: MuPACE: Learning to Pace Muon for LoRA Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Learning rate schedules are typically fixed before training begins, yet when fine-tuning large language models with low-rank adapters (LoRA), the appropriate scale varies substantially with the model, task, and adapter configuration.

Learning rate schedules are typically fixed before training begins, yet when fine-tuning large language models with low-rank adapters (LoRA), the appropriate scale varies substantially with the model, task, and adapter configuration. Practitioners re-tune a schedule for every new problem, yet a tuned schedule still cannot react to the training dynamics it encounters. We instead amortize learning rate selection across LoRA fine-tuning problems. We leave the base optimizer, Muon, untouched, so that its normalized update fixes the direction, and meta-learn only the global step size. Our method MuPACE is a small recurrent policy, meta-trained across a distribution of fine-tuning runs, that conditions on the observed trajectory and emits bounded adjustments to an interpretable analytic schedule. On 64 fine-tuning problems, MuPACE outperforms standard fixed schedules at a strong shared default on 64-78% of problems and is on par with the same schedules with per-task tuned peaks. Meta-trained only on models with up to 16 layers, MuPACE transfers one-shot to unseen tasks on models as deep as 64 layers, such as Qwen3-32B and Qwen3.8-27B, where a single run remains competitive with swept sch…

item.title: Memory Bandwidth, Not FLOPs: Profiling and Accelerating Query-Based Segmentation Decoders on Edge GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 边缘 GPU 上查询式分割模型（FastInst、Mask2Former）的 Transformer 解码器性能瓶颈究竟在算力还是内存带宽？

方法： 在 Jetson Orin Nano 上用 FP16 roofline 分析 + 硬件 DRAM 计数器做细粒度剖析，确认瓶颈后提出 CompactInst：用无参数 4× 空间池化压缩解码器内激活传输量，辅以双卷积精化头恢复空间细节。

关键数字： 非 Tensor Core 聚合仅占 CUDA-core 理论峰值的 2.5%–6%，却吃掉解码器 53%–70% 时间和 61%–71% 的字节搬运；单 kernel 可占满 90% DRAM 带宽。CompactInst 在 Jetson Orin Nano 上解码加速明显。

为什么值得看： 常见误区是"边缘推理瓶颈在算力"，本文用硬数据证明是内存带宽，且给出了无需重训的轻量解决方案。

Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) supervise on the residual of a known differential operator. Many high-stakes inference problems admit no such operator: clinical signals, behavioral measurements, materials properties. We introduce the Manifold-Informed Neural Network (MINN), a PINN-parallel paradigm that replaces the physics operator residual with a manifold operator residual: a discrete Poisson equation $\mathbf{L}_G \mathbf{H} = s_φ(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{m})$ on a $k$-nearest-neighbor graph in the learned latent space, with a learned, task-aware source. item.title: Learning Computational Structure for Sample-Efficient Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Statistical learning in high dimensions suffers from the curse of dimensionality.

Statistical learning in high dimensions suffers from the curse of dimensionality. Fortunately, many functions of practical interest are compositionally sparse, meaning they admit a composition of local functions, each depending on only a few variables, allowing sample complexity to depend on local arity rather than ambient dimension. Yet realizing this benefit requires exploiting hidden compositional structure, which theory does not establish for practical gradient-based training. We study this gap with CSFRBench, a controlled benchmark that hides the target's compositional computation during training but retains it for diagnosis, and find that dense networks and sparsity-based baselines leave much of that benefit unrealized. Inspired by the spatial organization of biological neural circuits, we introduce Learned Wiring (LeWi): each neuron has a learned low-dimensional embedding, only nearby neurons connect, and embeddings and weights are trained jointly. LeWi improves sample efficiency on targets with hierarchical structure, intermediate reuse, or independent modules. Across 32 additional targets generated by independently sampled computation graphs, LeWi is the most sample-effici…

item.title: KPage: Cross-Block Page Compaction for Hardware-Efficient Sparse Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长序列视频 Transformer 的稀疏注意力中，3D token 布局常让选中块部分占用、浪费物理 tile 容量——能否跨逻辑块边界把有效 K/V 页压实进大 tile，提升硬件利用率？

方法 KPage 块稀疏注意力方案：加载时直接把有效 16 行 K/V 页跨逻辑块边界打包进大 tile（不在高带宽内存物化压缩张量）；Q 块在 64×256 与 128×128 tile 间路由以减 query 侧填充；精确掩码与 K/V 页打包在前反向保持原稀疏图。

关键数字 五个代表性负载上较 NVIDIA Block-Sparse Attention（BSA）前向 kernel 加速 1.35×–2.06×（几何平均 1.77×），完全占满块上近持平（1.03×）而 3D 部分块布局达 2.29×；物理 QK 对容量从 334.1G 降到 177.5G 而保留 160.6G 有效交互；SVG2 Wan 14B/720p 上较最强精确稀疏基线 1.49×、较 BSA 1.57×。

为什么值得看 系统性解决稀疏注意力"块内浪费"，跨开源稀疏基线全面占优，且合规审查后将开源并提交 PR 给 NVIDIA cuDNN Frontend。

item.title: JAXbounce: A Continuous-Control Pong-Like Benchmark for Active Inference Beyond Low Dimensional Environments
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

We introduce JAXbounce, a continuous control pong-like benchmark designed to evaluate active inference beyond discrete, low dimensional environments.

We introduce JAXbounce, a continuous control pong-like benchmark designed to evaluate active inference beyond discrete, low dimensional environments. JAXbounce combines continuous states and stochastic dynamics in discrete time with flexible and composable observation models that allow representing the environment as a state vector or a pixel grid, corruptible through the rich family of noise models we provide. It is fully differentiable and parallelisable in JAX. We run over 10,000 agent simulations on our environment comparing a baseline deterministic solution, to a state-based active inference agent with Unscented Kalman Filter perception and expected free energy planning, and a pixel based agent whose measurement model is a pretrained neural network encoder. All agents are evaluated across three scenarios of increasing difficulty with eight different noise conditions. Our experiments characterise how performance of continuous state agents scales with planning, planning horizons, observation modalities and knowledge of the noise process, exhibiting preference-oriented behaviour even in the presence of increasing uncertainty. We release JAXbounce as a reproducible benchmark for c…

item.title: Interflow: Breaking the Offline-Online Barrier for Private AI at the Edge
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 隐私保护 ML 在边缘部署受 MPC 非线性推理的高通信、高计算、高数据搬运成本制约，且离线相关随机数生成与在线执行解耦造成巨大内存压力与补货停顿——能否打破离线-在线壁垒？

方法 Interflow 算法-硬件协同：按批流水线化相关随机数生成与在线执行——当前批消耗预生成随机数执行安全非线性运算时，为下一批并行生成；用交错执行、高效数据搬运与硬件加速，把预处理从串行存储密集型变为连续重叠流水线。

关键数字 Zynq UltraScale+ ZCU102 上非线性吞吐 CNN 算子最高提升 1.55×、transformer 算子 1.48×；ResNet-50 加速 1.26×、BERT-base 1.21×；内存占用较基线最高降 37%。

为什么值得看 用软硬协同把 MPC 预处理的"离线-在线壁垒"拆成重叠流水线，边缘隐私推理的工程范本。

item.title: Foundation-Style Pretraining for Scalable and Transferable Distributed PV Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

The rapid growth of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation is increasing the demand for accurate forecasting across large numbers of geographically dispersed stations.

The rapid growth of distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation is increasing the demand for accurate forecasting across large numbers of geographically dispersed stations. Existing approaches are commonly developed for individual sites or specific forecasting horizons, requiring repeated training and maintenance as new stations are integrated and limiting direct reuse at previously unseen sites. To address this scalability gap, this paper presents a domain-specific foundation-style pretraining framework that learns a shared forecasting model from heterogeneous multi-site and multi-horizon PV data. NWP-assisted forecasting is formulated as a sequence-completion problem that unifies historical PV power, meteorological observations, future numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts, and time encodings. Three pretraining objectives are designed and systematically evaluated, including forecast-aligned reconstruction, generic reconstruction, and mixed reconstruction. The mixed objective combines the operational structure of PV forecasting with random sequence reconstruction and provides the most balanced performance across forecasting accuracy, degraded NWP conditions, and downstream ada…

item.title: Evaluating Runtime Prediction and Conservative Walltime Policies in HPC Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Efficient use of large-scale supercomputing systems depends on accurate runtime estimation and walltime selection.

Efficient use of large-scale supercomputing systems depends on accurate runtime estimation and walltime selection. To avoid premature termination, users often overestimate walltime, leading to poor resource utilization and reduced scheduling efficiency. This paper presents a predictor-agnostic framework for safe walltime recommendation in production HPC environments. Rather than proposing a new runtime prediction model, the primary contribution is the SAFE decision layer, which converts predicted runtimes into conservative bounded walltime recommendations suitable for deployment. Runtime prediction is therefore treated as a modular component within the proposed framework. We evaluate the approach using large-scale production job histories from the Fugaku and NREL Eagle supercomputers, comprising approximately 24M and 11M jobs, respectively. Runtime prediction performance is first evaluated using representative predictors, including linear regression, neural networks, and a neural ensemble. The proposed SAFE framework is then evaluated using the NN ensemble predictor. Experimental results indicate that similarity-aware prediction substantially improves runtime estimation for workloa…

item.title: Efficient Edge-aware Attention Network for Graph Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features.

Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features. However, these architectures do not directly benefit from recent hardware-aware attention implementations, limiting their scalability. The adaptation is, however, non-trivial: edge and graph-level features must be injected into pairwise attention scores, graph masks must be respected, and dynamic edge updates remain a major source of quadratic memory usage. We propose an edge-aware attention layer for graph generation that incorporates structural information through head-wise score modulation, while updating edge representations with a lightweight residual mechanism that retains attention-score dependent edge updates. This layer can be effectively implemented using PyTorch's FlexAttention. We achieve similar generation quality to our baseline while reducing peak GPU memory by around 65% and substantially improving training and sampling throughput. These results suggest that the proposed architecture is a practical step toward scalable graph foundation models.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Don't Skip the Baseline: A Controlled Comparison of Dynamic Expert Skipping in MoEs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 动态专家跳过方法声称保持质量的同时进一步减少激活参数，但校准机制、缩减幅度与评测套件各异让对比失真——它们真能胜过简单的静态 k 缩减吗？

方法 把四种代表性动态跳过方法归入统一分类，与"所有层所有 token 缩到相同 k"的静态基线做匹配专家计算预算的受控对比；覆盖 Gemma4-26B-A4B、Qwen3-30B-A3B 文本与 Qwen3-VL 多模态。

关键数字 简单静态基线难以被动态方法稳定超越，方法常落后基线、即便有增益也很小；校准得到的 effective k 与测试期有效 k 会偏离，导致推理算力被高估或低估；据此推荐免校准、按模态静态 k 缩减并在留出模型/模态上验证。

为什么值得看 纠正"动态跳过"文献的对比幻觉，明确静态控制是任何动态方法必须击败的基准。

item.title: DiffRMST: A GPU-Accelerated Fully Differentiable Rectilinear Minimum Spanning Tree Wirelength Model for Global Placement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Analytical global placement requires a differentiable wirelength objective that accurately reflects routed interconnect cost.

Analytical global placement requires a differentiable wirelength objective that accurately reflects routed interconnect cost. The widely used half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL) is efficient but overlooks the internal topology of multi-pin nets. The rectilinear Steiner minimum tree (RSMT) provides higher fidelity, but its underlying decision problem is NP-complete, and its discrete construction precludes direct use in gradient-based optimization. The rectilinear minimum spanning tree (RMST) offers a polynomial-time alternative, but remains nondifferentiable because of minimization over discrete spanning trees. To address these limitations, we present DiffRMST, a fully differentiable RMST wirelength model for analytical global placement. DiffRMST combines spatial smoothing with a log-sum-exp relaxation to define a continuous distribution over spanning trees. Based on the Kirchhoff matrix-tree theorem, the partition function and edge marginals can be computed without explicit tree enumeration, enabling a closed-form topology-aware gradient for placement optimization. For efficient integration into analytical placement, we further develop a fused forward-backward operator with parallel C…

item.title: Detection of Memorization in Diffusion Models Through Thermodynamic Singularity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

In diffusion models, proper distributional learning entails reversing a diffusion process over underlying density functions, whereas a key failure is memorization, in which the reverse process instead learns diffusion from individual training samples.

In diffusion models, proper distributional learning entails reversing a diffusion process over underlying density functions, whereas a key failure is memorization, in which the reverse process instead learns diffusion from individual training samples. We provide an analytical characterization of such memorized reverse processes, along with a criterion that detects the associated thermodynamic singularity. The proposed criterion reliably distinguishes between properly learned and memorizing networks across a range of neural network models designed to promote or mitigate memorization.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Data-Driven Prediction of Optimal MPI Rank Placement and Node Count for Memory-Bound CFD on AMD EPYC Clusters
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Users who run a memory-bound OpenFOAM case on an AMD EPYC cluster must decide how many nodes to use and how many MPI ranks to place on each core complex.

Users who run a memory-bound OpenFOAM case on an AMD EPYC cluster must decide how many nodes to use and how many MPI ranks to place on each core complex. The fastest choice is often not the cheapest one. This paper revisits our earlier analytical model of this performance and energy trade-off with 560 measured configurations of the motorBike case on five Zen 4 and Zen 5 EPYC processors, including socket power from processor telemetry. On up to four nodes, small meshes are both fastest and cheapest on a single node on most processors. For the largest mesh the largest node count is both the fastest and the cheapest option, because its speedup is superlinear. A genuine trade-off arises only for medium meshes, where full speed costs a median of 20 to 97% more node hours than the cheapest option. The L3 miss rate and the halo traffic per cell are consistent with this pattern. For a new mesh of the same case, the configuration that was optimal on the nearest measured mesh is near optimal in 75 to 85% of the decisions. Running the two configurations it recommends for speed and for cost raises this share to 85 to 90% for runtime and node hours and determines the trade-off with median error…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Constrained Federated Reinforcement Learning for Secure Offloading in Vehicular Edge Computing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers.

Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers. Real vehicular workloads, however, consist of dependent subtasks with stringent reliability needs, while the cross-region collaborative learning used to adapt offloading policies must stay robust to heterogeneous data and secure over open wireless channels. We propose CRAFT, a Constrained Reinforcement-based Adaptive Federated Task Offloading framework that casts Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-structured offloading and resource allocation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process. CRAFT couples centralized-critic policy learning with Lagrangian relaxation to explicitly regulate the long-term task-completion constraint, and uses two-tier federated aggregation with proximal regularization to jointly mitigate non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) drift and stabilize constraint adaptation. Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers.

Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC) reduces latency for computation-intensive vehicular applications by offloading tasks to roadside edge servers. Real vehicular workloads, however, consist of dependent subtasks with stringent reliability needs, while the cross-region collaborative learning used to adapt offloading policies must stay robust to heterogeneous data and secure over open wireless channels. We propose CRAFT, a Constrained Reinforcement-based Adaptive Federated Task Offloading framework that casts Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)-structured offloading and resource allocation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process. CRAFT couples centralized-critic policy learning with Lagrangian relaxation to explicitly regulate the long-term task-completion constraint, and uses two-tier federated aggregation with proximal regularization to jointly mitigate non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) drift and stabilize constraint adaptation. item.title: Coincidence-Maximizing Customer Clustering Using Smart Meter Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Electricity distribution planning depends on peak-demand coincidence within customer groups, yet similarity-based clustering of smart-meter data does not optimize it directly.

Electricity distribution planning depends on peak-demand coincidence within customer groups, yet similarity-based clustering of smart-meter data does not optimize it directly. We formulate customer grouping to maximize the average of group coincidence factors, weighted by each group's daily share of summed individual peak demand. We prove that jointly optimizing memberships and group peak times is strongly NP-hard even for two groups. We therefore develop a fixed-peak refinement procedure applicable to any feasible partition. It alternates between identifying group peak times and exactly reassigning customers under minimum group-size constraints. Each polynomial-time reassignment maximizes a lower bound tight at the current partition, so accepted updates strictly improve weighted coincidence. We initialize refinement by clustering individual peak-time distributions and evaluate the method on four public smart-meter panels (27,654 customers) using chronological holdouts and 200 paired replicates with complete refitting. Machine learning-based fault detectors are often evaluated at the relay locations used for training, although local voltage and current measurements vary across power networks.

Machine learning-based fault detectors are often evaluated at the relay locations used for training, although local voltage and current measurements vary across power networks. This work investigates cross-relay generalization for binary detection of faults anywhere in the network using local measurements, rather than line-selective tripping. Using 50 ms windows from a simulated 110 kV transmission network, we evaluate a multilayer perceptron across all 64 source target combinations of eight relays and five random seeds. A shared simulation-level split and source-only threshold selection provide a controlled held-out evaluation without target-specific calibration. Despite nearly unchanged mean F1-scores (0.730 within-relay versus 0.734 cross-relay), the mean false-positive rate (FPR) increases from 0.088 to 0.341, while the mean false-negative rate decreases from 0.399 to 0.318. item.title: Can Native Safety Travel? Reusing Safety Pretraining Across Models via On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Safety pretraining has emerged as a promising paradigm for embedding safety deeply into a model during pretraining, yielding robustness to subsequent fine-tuning that conventional safety post-training often lacks.

Safety pretraining has emerged as a promising paradigm for embedding safety deeply into a model during pretraining, yielding robustness to subsequent fine-tuning that conventional safety post-training often lacks. We refer to this safety acquired during model pretraining as native safety. Yet native safety is expensive to acquire, confined to the model in which it was pretrained, and often accompanied by lower general utility. In this work, we rethink the practical value of safety-pretrained models and introduce, for the first time, the native safety reuse problem: Can native safety be transferred from a specialized, potentially smaller, safety-pretrained "teacher" to standard-pretrained "students," enabling them to inherit its robustness while preserving their general utility? We show that native safety can "travel" through on-policy distillation. A standard-pretrained student generates responses to safety-pretraining prompts, while a small safety-pretrained teacher supervises the student's token-level predictions along its own generated trajectories; cross-tokenizer alignment further enables transfer across model families. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

A cluster admission gate can receive a capacity record that no longer matches current schedulability.

A cluster admission gate can receive a capacity record that no longer matches current schedulability. We study one exogenous binary schedulability unit under a bound on the joint probability of admission and unavailability. For a symmetric Markov state, we derive the stationary admission frontier for a fixed observation delay and apply finite likelihood allocation to a delay-tagged delivered record. A one-sided exact binomial endpoint calibrates each fitted policy, and exact enumeration confirms the per-policy confidence target in every tested parameter cell. A separate deterministic guard charges every unresolved admission against the realized allowance and bounds unavailable-state admissions at every prefix under truthful outcome feedback. An executable admission procedure composes the allocation and guard. The controlled system binds source sampling, NATS delivery, randomized admission, Kubernetes objects, and API-derived outcomes in one append-only record. item.title: Binary Discrete Diffusion: Candidate-Set Diffusion for Logic and Planning Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities.

Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities. This makes them promising candidates for reasoning, planning, and constrained-generation tasks like coding and math. Yet masked and uniform diffusion erase a token's identity in a single corruption event, so their noisy states cannot explicitly represent partially resolved uncertainty in which several alternatives remain plausible. We close this gap with Binary Discrete Diffusion, a family of continuous-time discrete-diffusion processes whose noisy state is a set of candidate tokens per position, represented as a binary membership vector. Binary diffusion changes candidate sets through additions and removals, allowing information to be lost and recovered gradually while the diffusion state itself represents partial uncertainty. On Sudoku-Extreme, Boxoban, and graph coloring, the symmetric formulation of binary diffusion consistently outperforms strong, well-tuned masked and uniform baselines under matched architectures and controlled training, sampling, and tuning budgets, with its largest gains on the harde…

item.title: Beyond the Point Mass: Acceptance-Derived Weights and Distributional Losses for Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 推测解码里 draft 模型训练（如 D-PACE）用点质量 CE 损失、只取 draft 对已记录目标 token 的概率——但拒绝采样下 draft token 被接受的概率实为 draft 与目标分布的重叠（1−总变差距离），能否据此导出更准的训练信号？

方法 从期望接受长度的精确式推导 D-PAL：以分布重叠作为接受信号，得到重叠度位置权重 + 每位置 log 接受（LA）损失，点质量目标下退化为 D-PACE；权重 detached 后任意每位置损失可替换 LA；证明 Rényi-1/2 从上下两侧夹住真实接受率。

关键数字 Qwen3-4B 目标下六个基准平均接受长度 D-PACE 4.50→D-PAL 4.57（T=0）、4.20→4.28（T=1），两个温度下吞吐均更高；Rényi-1/2 替换 CE 在 D-PACE 与 D-PAL 两种权重下都提升接受长度。

为什么值得看 从分布重叠而非点质量推导 draft 训练目标，理论推导与实测一致的推测解码加速新配方。

item.title: Benchmarking CPU, GPU, and ML Power-Flow Solvers from 14 to 70,000 Buses
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Learned surrogates for power-flow (PF) computation are usually motivated by speed, compared against a single CPU-based baseline.

Learned surrogates for power-flow (PF) computation are usually motivated by speed, compared against a single CPU-based baseline. We show this comparison is fragile: across 7 open-source CPU-based solvers evaluated on identical inputs, throughput varies by roughly 2.5-3 orders of magnitude, so the choice of baseline alone can flip the conclusion. We build a benchmark spanning 9 physics-based solvers: 7 CPU-based and 2 GPU-based, including a new batched GPU solver, gumsim2grid - and 3 published ML surrogates, evaluated under a shared, independently implemented KCL-mismatch check across 15 grids from 14 to 70,000 buses. On the PF task itself, a sufficiently parallelized CPU solver or gpusim2grid matches or exceeds the throughput of the ML surrogates we test while remaining orders of magnitude more accurate; we find no evidence that these GNN-style surrogates are yet competitive for PF specifically, though prior work reports genuine gains on related but more combinatorial tasks such as optimal power flow or power grid control. Beyond this finding, we hope the benchmark suite, code and reference evaluator released at https://github.com/Grid2op/gpusim2grid helps close a broader reproduci…

item.title: BCT: Bayes-Consistent Tempering for Flow Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Temperature scaling is typically applied as a post-hoc transformation of model probabilities.

Temperature scaling is typically applied as a post-hoc transformation of model probabilities. In posterior-induced flow language models, this creates two mismatches. First, posterior tempering implicitly changes both the endpoint distribution and the distribution of intermediate noisy states, while the denoiser remains trained on the original states. Second, the tempered posterior weights are combined with transport dynamics derived for the untempered flow. These mismatches are reflected empirically: lowering temperature improves GSM8K performance much less reliably in flow LMs than in discrete diffusion LMs. We introduce Bayes-Consistent Tempering (BCT), which makes temperature explicit in both the distributions and dynamics of the generative flow. Its learned realization trains the denoiser on tempered intermediate states and tempers the endpoint distribution using the corresponding tempered dynamics. We also derive training-free variants for conventionally trained checkpoints. Memory-based temporal graph neural networks (TGN) rely on recurrent node memories to capture evolving interaction histories.

Memory-based temporal graph neural networks (TGN) rely on recurrent node memories to capture evolving interaction histories. However, temporal mini-batching introduces a trade-off between computational efficiency and temporal fidelity: when a node appears multiple times within the same batch, later interactions are evaluated using stale pre-batch memory because the intermediate memory updates have not yet been committed. This problem becomes more severe as temporal batch size increases. To overcome this challenge, we propose AnchorRM, an anchor-based residual memory mechanism that reconstructs event-specific intra-batch node states without executing sequential recurrent updates. AnchorRM treats the last committed node memory at the beginning of each batch as a pre-batch fixed anchor and uses causally preceding same-batch interactions to infer the missing state evolution relative to that anchor. The learned residual then calibrates the anchor to reconstruct an event-specific node memory for each interaction. item.title: Adaptive Pullback: Reweighting Supervision at Penalty Jumps in On-Policy Distillation
item.description:

On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios.

On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios. A positive log-ratio penalizes a token that the student assigns higher probability to than the teacher, but its current value does not distinguish sustained high penalties from abrupt increases along a response. We examine these local changes by comparing consecutive blocks of tokens within the same response. Our diagnostic identifies penalty jumps, abrupt increases in average penalty that persist on held-out tokens. Across these jumps, penalties rise while teacher confidence decreases. We call this pattern penalty-confidence tension. Boundaries into high-penalty blocks do not exhibit comparable confidence changes, showing that local changes provide information beyond the current penalty value. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Pullback OPD (AP-OPD). At each detected jump, AP-OPD uses the preceding block as a local reference and uniformly scales all supervision coefficients in the following block so that its weighted average penalty matches the preceding block's original mean. On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios.

On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios. A positive log-ratio penalizes a token that the student assigns higher probability to than the teacher, but its current value does not distinguish sustained high penalties from abrupt increases along a response. We examine these local changes by comparing consecutive blocks of tokens within the same response. Our diagnostic identifies penalty jumps, abrupt increases in average penalty that persist on held-out tokens. Across these jumps, penalties rise while teacher confidence decreases. We call this pattern penalty-confidence tension. Boundaries into high-penalty blocks do not exhibit comparable confidence changes, showing that local changes provide information beyond the current penalty value. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Pullback OPD (AP-OPD). At each detected jump, AP-OPD uses the preceding block as a local reference and uniformly scales all supervision coefficients in the following block so that its weighted average penalty matches the preceding block's original mean. This reference determines the scaling factor without an additional strength…

item.title: AC/DC on a Budget - Alternating Sparse Phases
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

State-of-the-art neural network sparsification relies on alternating dense and sparse training phases.

State-of-the-art neural network sparsification relies on alternating dense and sparse training phases. While computationally expensive, dense phases are critical for performance. Our empirical analysis reveals the mechanics behind this gain: upon reintroduction, previously masked parameters receive disproportionately large gradients that drive essential mask rewiring and parameter sign-flipping. Building on these insights, we optimize the performance-to-FLOPs Pareto frontier through three innovations: (1) zero-initializing masked parameters during dense phases to promote relevant sign flips, (2) shortening dense phases, and (3) replacing the dense phase entirely with a sparse rewiring phase that updates only the active mask and a small, high-gradient fraction of out-of-mask weights. Evaluated on CIFAR100 and ImageNet, our variant ARC (Alternating Rewiring Compression) matches baseline AC/DC performance at a fraction of the computational cost, establishing a superior performance-to-FLOPs frontier also compared to standard sparse-to-sparse algorithms. Experiments with GPT-2 on OpenWebText further show improvements in validation perplexity and average zero-shot performance

item.title: A Taxonomy of Predicate Transformer Monads for Specifying Monadic Programs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Monads of weakest precondition predicate transformers are the foundation of several verification frameworks for monadic programs.

Monads of weakest precondition predicate transformers are the foundation of several verification frameworks for monadic programs. For specifying monadic computations with nondeterminism and nontermination, in addition to weakest preconditions, we introduce the first strongest postcondition monads covering all combinations of angelic or demonic nondeterminism and partial or total interpretations of nontermination. For extending these base strongest postcondition monads with side effects such as mutable state, monad transformers do not yield the expected monads, so we instead generalize the base monads to arrows and use arrow transformers. We give a taxonomy of weakest precondition and strongest postcondition monads, for the base monads and for their versions with state, and show that the known relationships between under- and over-approximate triples based on predicate transformers already hold at the level of the predicate transformers themselves. We use the predicate transformer monads to define under- and over-approximate triples and, where possible, Dijkstra monads. Finally, we relate these two specification styles.

item.title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensi

Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. item.title: Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering l

LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering latency. Finding good assignments incurs a separate search cost from evaluating multiple candidates. We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins), a multi-objective extension of single-objective cost-aware Gittins search for Pareto recommendation. It exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs: assignments that cost more to deploy also cost more to evaluate. The search alternates between seeking higher quality and lower deployment cost, reusing each evaluation to inform both searches. After each batch, CC-Gittins recommends assignments that are nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted estimates of quality and deployment cost. We evaluate CC-Gittins on eight quality--cost matrices from workflows with two to five roles and up to 1,681 candidate assignments. We also evaluate the method with latency as a third objective. Across the eight benchmarks, CC-Gittins recovers a substantial fraction of the true Pareto frontier at roughly 10% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost, and recovers …

item.title: Wet-Biased Data Pipelines Mislead the Training and Evaluation of Generative Precipitation Nowcasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Generative models for precipitation nowcasting are trained and evaluated predominantly on wet-biased datasets, which over-represent precipitation events to emphasize rare extremes. Selecting

Generative models for precipitation nowcasting are trained and evaluated predominantly on wet-biased datasets, which over-represent precipitation events to emphasize rare extremes. Selecting test cases based on target observations is known to favor forecasts that match the selected distribution rather than the intended deployment distribution. We show analytically how this target-dependent sampling also shifts the conditional distribution learned by generative models. When training and test sampling match, even an ideal model learns precisely the distribution favored by evaluation, allowing the evaluation bias to conceal the training bias. Using a fixed satellite-to-radar diffusion model, we demonstrate that target-dependent test sampling can reverse the calibration assessment. The model appears under-predictive on a wet-biased test set but over-predictive on a deployment-representative test set. This result is replicated outside the model's training domain after a seven-year gap. Utilizing classifier-free guidance as an example, we demonstrate how the contradictory calibration assessment can misdirect downstream model development.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Weighted State Souping for Efficient Long-Context Retrieval
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

State space models (SSMs) combine fast inference and fixed state size with competitive language-modeling performance. Recently, state souping has been proposed as a procedure whereby an SSM

State space models (SSMs) combine fast inference and fixed state size with competitive language-modeling performance. Recently, state souping has been proposed as a procedure whereby an SSM independently encodes chunks of tokens like documents, tool definitions, or memory records. The resulting state encodings may be cached and recombined to cheaply construct a context for downstream queries. However, both state souping and vanilla SSMs deteriorate on long, crowded contexts, limiting their utility for long-horizon domains. To address this issue, we propose weighted state souping, a simple method that learns query-dependent weights for composing cached states. The resulting models improve long-context performance substantially across both single- and multi-hop document question answering, needle-in-a-haystack retrieval, variable tracking, and tool use. Our method can be further adapted into an efficient sparse variant, yielding near-constant encoding cost with respect to context length while preserving (and sometimes improving) performance. We also present simple theoretical arguments that illustrate why souping works and when it may fail, and discuss informally the advantages of we…

item.title: VaDar: Implicit Goal Conditioning via Value Disaggregation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Long-horizon tasks are important for modern AI and robotics, yet pose a challenge for reinforcement learning. Historically, a popular approach has been to decompose a task into subgoals, and

Long-horizon tasks are important for modern AI and robotics, yet pose a challenge for reinforcement learning. Historically, a popular approach has been to decompose a task into subgoals, and learn a subgoal-conditioned policy to execute each subtask in sequence. We introduce an alternative called Value Disaggregation (VaDar), which trains a single subgoal-independent policy to maximize a linear combination of per-subgoal critic values. Because subgoal information is needed only at training-time, VaDar removes the need for possibly costly or cumbersome subgoal-selection during policy deployment. Moreover, through careful experiments, we show that VaDar (1) is always competitive with, and frequently outperforms, natural baselines like goal-conditioning and (2) succeeds on tasks with non-sequential goal structure and multiple optimization objectives. In particular, VaDar is the first algorithm to solve challenging, long-horizon tasks in the RoboCasa suite, even when starting from a policy pretrained from behavior cloning with near-zero initial task success. Taken together, VaDar's successes suggest that subgoal information benefits actor-critic reinforcement learning by enhancing the …

item.title: UtilityBench: Measuring Language Model Utility When Errors Have Different Costs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios with important outcomes, the impact of their mistakes often extends far beyond what correctness can capture. In domains l

As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios with important outcomes, the impact of their mistakes often extends far beyond what correctness can capture. In domains like medicine, a single error can lead to serious consequences and put patient safety at risk. However, mainstream evaluation protocols still treat all errors as equal, overlooking the spectrum of real-world costs. To address this, we propose a utility-based evaluation paradigm that explicitly incorporates the varying consequences of errors. Guided by this principle, we develop UtilityBench, a large-scale benchmark of 15,000 instances with verifiable answers, quantifying error severity using Best-Worst Scaling to elicit meaningful, data-driven cost estimates. These quantified utilities shape when a model should answer or abstain, guiding it to make decisions that align with the true importance of each scenario. As another merit, we introduce UtilityAUC, a metric that measures the area under the utility curve determined by a model's response ordering, thereby enabling utility preference alignment beyond error frequency.
