item.title: Exploration via Activation-Space Steering for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards.

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. We introduce Activation-Space Exploration (ASE), an online method for diversifying training rollouts. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k, ASE improves average Mean@8 across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks over GRPO by 4.87 and 1.87 percentage points, respectively, under the same rollout budget.

item.title: E-Layout: Layout-Stage Logic Restructuring via RL-Optimized Equality-Saturated Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.AR　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Achieving high sign-off performance in advanced ICs increasingly depends on layout-stage optimization under realistic physical conditions. While recent efforts have moved toward synthesis-la

Achieving high sign-off performance in advanced ICs increasingly depends on layout-stage optimization under realistic physical conditions. While recent efforts have moved toward synthesis-layout fusion, most existing works still focus on bringing estimated physical information earlier into synthesis, whose optimization does not fully correlate with real layout-stage behavior. Meanwhile, layout-stage optimization remains largely restricted to a fixed logic structure, relying mainly on buffering and sizing. This fundamentally constrains the optimization space under realistic physical conditions. To address this, we present E-Layout, an ML-driven framework for post-placement layout restructuring. E-Layout jointly optimizes logic transformation and physical implementation across multiple subcircuits under design-level timing feedback. This enables the selection of the most timing-beneficial set of disjoint restructured subcircuits to form the optimized circuit. Specifically, it first constructs equivalence-preserving logic alternatives via e-graph equality saturation, then couples logic selection with physical realization through a graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) model…

item.title: Dynamical Batching: How Class-Cycling Training Shapes the Internal Structure of Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

We investigate whether cyclically varying the class composition of training batches can modify both the performance and the internal organization of neural networks. Motivated by nonequilibr

We investigate whether cyclically varying the class composition of training batches can modify both the performance and the internal organization of neural networks. Motivated by nonequilibrium systems, in which cycling between related sub-goals can make switching between their solutions increasingly efficient, we introduce Dynamical Batching (DB), a sampling protocol that periodically emphasizes each class while leaving the loss and the optimizer unchanged, and compare it with Uniform Batching (UB), in which every mini-batch has equal class proportions. In the regime where standard training fails, DB changes the outcome: on a three-arm spiral, a capacity-limited MLP that plateaus far below perfect accuracy under UB fits the training data under DB. Tracking individual weights, we find that under DB the change between class-specialized states is carried by a smaller set of weights than under UB, and that this set is markedly more persistent from cycle to cycle, on every synthetic dataset we test and in a wider network that fits the data under both protocols. item.title: DeltaTrace: Efficient Signed Attribution for Reasoning Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

We study how words in the context support or oppose a language model's response and present DeltaTrace, a novel attribution framework that explains the effect of input tokens on a fixed mode

We study how words in the context support or oppose a language model's response and present DeltaTrace, a novel attribution framework that explains the effect of input tokens on a fixed model response. DeltaTrace measures how the response's log-probability changes when the context tokens being explained are masked. To distribute this difference among source tokens, it constructs operator-specific local rules for finite changes and composes them backward through the computational graph using effective secant slopes. Each token is assigned a signed attribution as the inner product of its embedding displacement and the corresponding backward-propagated slope. Local conservation makes these contributions sum to the measured score difference and preserves their meaning when aggregated over sentences or passages. DeltaTrace supports both attention and linear-attention models, with auxiliary memory growing linearly with sequence length at fixed model dimensions and chunk size. On the evaluated attention model, DeltaTrace achieves the lowest deletion-faithfulness scores (RISE and MAS) on most retrieval and reasoning tasks and the highest needle-in-a-haystack Recall, exceeding FlashTrace by…

item.title: Declarative Explanations for Graph Neural Networks: A Demonstration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven effective for graph analytical tasks, yet their "black-box" nature complicates the understanding of their layer-wise behavior and hinders their appli

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven effective for graph analytical tasks, yet their "black-box" nature complicates the understanding of their layer-wise behavior and hinders their application to large graphs. We demonstrate SliceGXQ, an end-to-end declarative and interactive system for querying and exploring layer-wise explanations for GNNs over large-scale graphs. In particular, SliceGXQ provides (1) an interactive graphical user interface for dataset, model, and explanation configuration; (2) a lightweight SPARQL-like parser that allows users to specify target nodes, layers, explanation modes, and constraints; and (3) an integrated execution and visualization workflow that invokes SliceGX as its underlying explanation engine. We demonstrate how users can diagnose a misclassified node, identify problematic layers and influential messages, and perform targeted model debugging, together with large-scale graph interpretation and fraud-detection analysis. Our demonstration video and source code are available at this https URL.

item.title: Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

LLMs "reason" by externalizing intermediate steps as tokens through chain-of-thought (CoT), yet even frontier reasoning models hit abrupt performance cliffs on long-horizon tasks. Implicit r

LLMs "reason" by externalizing intermediate steps as tokens through chain-of-thought (CoT), yet even frontier reasoning models hit abrupt performance cliffs on long-horizon tasks. Implicit reasoning (reasoning within a single forward pass) is useful during CoT generation, as the model can "search ahead" to decide the correct next move without explicit search. Models with weak implicit reasoning are more likely to commit to wrong paths and must attempt to recover via backtracking, while models with strong implicit reasoning identify the correct proof strategy directly, shortening the CoT. However, prior work shows LLMs struggle to reason implicitly beyond shallow depths, with no relief from scale. We investigate whether curriculum learning can extend this depth by fine-tuning on examples with progressively increasing vocabulary size and lookahead (the number of steps a model must search ahead to identify the correct next move). At matched compute, curriculum-trained models achieve lookaheads where no-curriculum training fails. Qwen3-0.6B reaches 98% accuracy on problems with lookahead up to 256 with curriculum, compared to 45% without. However, progress slows as fine-tuning continue…

item.title: Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can

Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.

item.title: Concerns in Benchmarking Jailbreaks: An Empirical Study of Attack Success Rates
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Jailbreak methods are commonly compared using Attack Success Rate (ASR), but these comparisons depend on how responses are generated and judged. In this paper, we examine eight attacks again

Jailbreak methods are commonly compared using Attack Success Rate (ASR), but these comparisons depend on how responses are generated and judged. In this paper, we examine eight attacks against three open-weight language models using three evaluation procedures. Low-resource language attacks achieve a mean ASR of 96.0% under keyword matching but 2.7% under a Qwen3 evaluator following StrongREJECT scoring instructions. Changing the number and arrangement of attempts reverses the ranking of DeepInception and rewriting. In a separate experiment, sampling 100 responses for each unchanged request at Ollama's default temperature of 0.8 yields 100% ASR under keyword matching but 50% under the Qwen3 evaluator. Beyond evaluator sensitivity, these findings raise a safety concern: repeated sampling can expose residual unsafe behavior despite an initial refusal, suggesting probabilistic suppression rather than robust exclusion. We recommend explicit success definitions, matched response budgets, validated evaluators, and reporting cumulative failure under repeated interaction rather than relying on single-generation tests.

item.title: Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoni

Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file's lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little to rule-following, although it helps one model complete the task. The benefit depends on what the reasoning says. item.title: Compiling Environment Classifiers to Contextual Modal Types
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.PL　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Type systems for metaprogramming take one of two approaches to safeguarding the scopes of variables in generated code. They either use Environment Classifiers (EC) to identify scopes by name

Type systems for metaprogramming take one of two approaches to safeguarding the scopes of variables in generated code. They either use Environment Classifiers (EC) to identify scopes by name (Taha and Nielsen, 2003), or they use Contextual Modal Type Theory (CMTT) to match scopes by structure (Nanevski, Pfenning, and Pientka, 2008). In this paper, we connect these two approaches by compiling a calculus with polymorphic environment classifiers, subtyping, and mutable references to a CMTT-based calculus with polymorphic contexts, mutable references, and first-class substitutions. The key idea is to map each environment classifier to a context. We prove that the compilation preserves types and that compilation preserves the behavior of metaprograms. Both proofs are mechanized in Agda. The compilation shows that CMTT is at least as expressive as environment classifiers. We conjecture that the converse compilation is difficult, because environment classifiers impose a stricter regime on the metaprogram.

item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) is a distributed paradigm for Internet of Things (IoT) edge networks. However, deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over wireless edge networks presents distinct c

Federated learning (FL) is a distributed paradigm for Internet of Things (IoT) edge networks. However, deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over wireless edge networks presents distinct challenges: large model parameters increase uplink transmission latency over bandwidth-constrained fading channels, and non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) data exacerbates client drift. Existing feature alignment solutions often introduce auxiliary computations that consume time slots allocated for wireless parameter transmission, increasing the likelihood of straggler dropouts under system delay constraints. To address these issues, we propose DPGR-GCAM, a communication-efficient federated domain generalization framework. By employing a dual-parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) architecture, we design a channel-aware tiered transmission mechanism that adaptively truncates payloads to maximize node survival rates under fading conditions. To mitigate client drift, we introduce the Gradient-Conflict Aware Modulation (GCAM) mechanism. GCAM operates within the low-dimensional feature manifold to dynamically resolve multi-objective optimization conflicts with minimal edge computat…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Split Federated Learning (SFL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training large-scale deep models on resource-constrained edge devices.

Split Federated Learning (SFL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training large-scale deep models on resource-constrained edge devices. Although asynchronous SFL alleviates the straggler bottleneck caused by system heterogeneity, it inevitably introduces two coupled dimensions of inconsistency: horizontal inconsistency across clients and vertical inconsistency between clients and the server. These inconsistencies, further exacerbated by statistical heterogeneity, result in biased activation representations, model divergence, and severe client drift. To address these challenges, we propose CoASFL, an inconsistency-aware asynchronous SFL framework that incorporates a dynamic activation merging mechanism and a consistency-aware model aggregation mechanism. Specifically, CoASFL constructs more consistent activation sequences from heterogeneous clients to alleviate horizontal inconsistency, and dynamically adjusts aggregation weights according to client participation frequencies and progress gaps to mitigate vertical inconsistency. item.title: ClockMark: Adaptive and Host-Dependent Watermarking for Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Large language model (LLM) watermarking operates on the next-token distribution that evolves during generation.

Large language model (LLM) watermarking operates on the next-token distribution that evolves during generation. In streaming generation, each sampled token becomes part of the text and affects subsequent distributions. Embedding therefore proceeds with a changing host, unlike classical watermarking, which adapts embedding to an existing host signal. To accommodate this difference, we formulate a novel embedding framework for LLM watermarking based on two principles. We first argue that embedding should be adaptive, retaining the state of previous sampling decisions to better guide subsequent choices. We further argue that embedding should be host-dependent, using the current LLM distribution to constrain both token selection and state updates. Guided by these principles and the two requirements of distribution preservation and robustness to text editing, we propose ClockMark. It combines adaptive and host-dependent embedding with message spreading, embedding the full payload in each watermarked token. Theoretically, we prove that ClockMark preserves the original LLM sequence distribution, thereby maintaining generation quality. Empirically, extensive experiments against 12 baseline…

item.title: Can Metadata Fix the Gauge? Calibration Turns Sparse Multi-Source Learning from Sparse PCA into Sparse Mean Recovery
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Source labels tell us where a sample came from, but not how that source oriented its coordinates. In a sparse Gaussian multi-source model with source-specific sign gauges, that distinction c

Source labels tell us where a sample came from, but not how that source oriented its coordinates. In a sparse Gaussian multi-source model with source-specific sign gauges, that distinction changes the learning problem. Without calibration, pooling across sources erases the mean signal, and the source-labelled experiment reduces to sparse PCA. With task-independent relative-gauge metadata, synchronization aligns sources and the same observations become a sparse mean problem. We formalize the value of metadata through AlignedMass, which quantifies how much first-order signal a metadata-induced alignment restores. Source labels create only limited AlignedMass, whereas valid calibration can create AlignedMass proportional to the full sample size. This yields a statistical separation in micro-source regimes and, under standard sparse-PCA hardness assumptions, a computational separation as well. Synthetic experiments check the predicted scaling; controlled real-feature and physical sensor studies examine sign cancellation, separately acquired calibration, and reuse across tasks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: CTLite: Lightweight Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Reusable Continuous-Time Summaries
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Irregular multivariate time series forecasting (IMTSF) requires capturing temporal dynamics and cross-variable dependencies from sparse, asynchronous observations. Existing methods often rel

Irregular multivariate time series forecasting (IMTSF) requires capturing temporal dynamics and cross-variable dependencies from sparse, asynchronous observations. Existing methods often rely on learned temporal encoders, coupling historical representation construction with model optimisation and repeatedly processing the same observations. We propose CTLite, a lightweight forecasting framework that decouples historical summarisation from learned prediction. Specifically, a parameter-free continuous-time moment encoder summarises local levels and trends at multiple temporal scales while suppressing poorly supported slope estimates. A compact readout combines damped local extrapolation with a low-rank cross-variable correction that accounts for observation freshness, target availability, and forecast horizon. Since the historical summaries are independent of trainable parameters and forecast queries, they can be reused across optimisation steps and repeated predictions for an unchanged history without altering predictions or parameter gradients. Experiments on four real-world benchmarks show that CTLite achieves the best or second-best mean MSE and MAE among the evaluated methods wi…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

HPC facilities collect years of job scheduler records, yet much of this operational data remains underused because accessible tools for turning it into actionable insight are scarce. We pres

HPC facilities collect years of job scheduler records, yet much of this operational data remains underused because accessible tools for turning it into actionable insight are scarce. We present CQTwin, an open-source digital-twin toolkit for operational analytics of HPC scheduling data. CQTwin addresses this gap through two complementary modes: offline trace replay and online event-driven simulation. Built on the Python-based CQSim discrete-event simulator, CQTwin combines a fidelity-validated, high-performance C++ engine with an interactive browser-based dashboard and a Snapshot Lab, enabling facility staff, operators, and researchers to characterize workloads, compare scheduling policies, and explore what-if scenarios. As an offline twin, CQTwin replays archived workload traces under alternative policies to show how the same workload would have unfolded under different scheduling decisions. As an online twin, it consumes job events as they arrive and projects how alternative policies would process the currently queued jobs, providing guidance for real-time decision-making. The dashboard supports the complete analysis workflow, including workload characterization, experiment confi…

item.title: CEMA-Router: Infrastructure-Aware Batch Routing for LLM Inference in Cloud-Edge Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 被集成进跨异构云边资源的普适应用后，节点在算力、能效、网络条件与所部署模型质量上差异显著，路由需在响应质量、货币成本、能耗与批次完成时间之间取舍；而现有 LLM router 多按模型质量与 token 成本逐查询决策，云边调度器又常忽略模型质量差异，四目标协调不足。

方法 提出基础设施感知的批量路由器 CEMA-Router：把批量路由建模为多目标搜索问题，联合最小化模型质量损失、货币成本、能耗与受长尾任务支配的批次完成时间；用面向路由的 memetic 算法高效搜索，结合最大请求优先的负载感知播种与概率化、评估器引导的 Lamarckian 修复；决策依据部署相关节点画像、动态积压估计与模型质量信号；并实现为含请求管理器、路由服务与剖析器的端到端系统，支持真实云边部署与轨迹驱动仿真。

关键数字 用 RouterBench 轨迹与 GSM8K、MMLU 负载在异构云边测试床上评测，相对 SOTA 方法加权目标在 GSM8K 上最多降低 86%、MMLU 上降低 80%；能耗分别最多降 33% 与 19%；批次完成时间分别最多降 27% 与 30%。

为什么值得看 把"质量/钱/能耗/尾延迟"四个互相打架的目标收进同一个搜索，云边推理的路由决策终于不必再靠拍脑袋。

item.title: Bridging In-Situ Visualization to Game Engines: From ParaView Catalyst via ANARI to Unreal Engine
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

In-situ high-performance computing (HPC) simulations produce massive datasets that remain difficult to stream into game engines for interactive visualization. We present an in-situ, disk-fre

In-situ high-performance computing (HPC) simulations produce massive datasets that remain difficult to stream into game engines for interactive visualization. We present an in-situ, disk-free pipeline that couples simulation data to Unreal Engine 5 through ParaView's ANARI rendering API. A modified ANARI-USD device captures Universal Scene Description (USD) scene graphs in memory at the ANARI layer and streams the engine-agnostic USD format through an embedded ZeroMQ broker to visualization clients, where JuSync, middleware with a companion Unreal Engine 5 plugin, parses the geometry as it arrives and routes it to engine rendering components at runtime, producing scenes that are camera-navigable once received. The decoupled design keeps simulation execution independent of visualization load, and clients may connect or disconnect at any time. The pipeline is demonstrated on the JURECA-DC supercomputer at Forschungszentrum Jülich, streaming Free Electron Laser (FEL) simulation data with point clouds of tens of millions of particles.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Blame-aware Recomposition for Secure Compilation Proofs of Low-Level Compartment Isolation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.PL　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

The security guarantees of existing formally verified compilers for compartmentalized programs in unsafe languages like C stop at a rather high level, assuming a built-in protection mechanis

The security guarantees of existing formally verified compilers for compartmentalized programs in unsafe languages like C stop at a rather high level, assuming a built-in protection mechanism and a block-based memory model. Verifying a concrete, low-level enforcement mechanism for compartment isolation is still a major challenge for current proof techniques. In particular, Abate et al.'s proof technique fails because one of their proof steps, recomposition, essentially requires hiding all information about the code of each compartment, which is not practically achievable at a low level. We propose an extension of their proof technique to a low-level setting where compartments can fully observe each other's code. To do so, we introduce an overlay semantics that allows us to characterize these observations as a form of undefined behaviour, and we use a novel variant of recomposition that we call blame-aware recomposition, which essentially allows recomposing executions as needed in the original high-level proof technique, even if the low-level context observes the code, because this context is ultimately going to be discarded. item.title: Bayesian Model Discovery with Language Models: Closing the Loop between Hypotheses and Experiments
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Scientific model discovery requires proposing candidate models of an unknown system and designing experiments that discriminate among them. However, LLM-based approaches typically rely on in

Scientific model discovery requires proposing candidate models of an unknown system and designing experiments that discriminate among them. However, LLM-based approaches typically rely on in-context learning to predict outcomes and select experiments, lacking explicit model evaluation to systematically guide hypothesis search, while Bayesian approaches enable principled model comparison but are confined to a predefined candidate set which results in limited search spaces. To this end, we introduce BMD, which closes the loop between LLM-driven hypothesis generation and Bayesian experimental design. Specifically, an LLM proposes model families, while a numerical engine fits their parameters, weighs them by model evidence, and averages their predictions. Then, BMD chooses the next experimental conditions by maximizing the joint expected information gain over families and their parameters, while feeding the updated beliefs and residual diagnostics back to the LLM to guide its next proposals. Across four scientific discovery benchmarks, BMD achieves lowest final prediction error than in-context learning and LLM-based scientific agents while recovering exact functional forms more often, …

item.title: Automated Brick Schema Knowledge Graph Completion Across Buildings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

The Brick schema represents building equipment, sensors, spaces, and the relationships between them as typed, multi-relational graphs, providing machine-readable metadata that supports generalizable control applications.

The Brick schema represents building equipment, sensors, spaces, and the relationships between them as typed, multi-relational graphs, providing machine-readable metadata that supports generalizable control applications. Current methods for producing complete Brick models require extensive manual examination of building schematics and point lists. We observe that as Brick models are knowledge graphs, inferring missing relations is naturally posed as a knowledge graph completion problem. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of knowledge graph completion to Brick model generation. We compare three methods, gradient-boosted trees, Pairwise Brick Relation Ranking, and CompGCN, on the relations feeds, hasPart, and hasPoint, which account for the majority of the schematic-reading work in building a Brick model by hand. Models are evaluated on held-out MORTAR buildings and out-of-distribution Kaggle and Building Time Series data. Although CompGCN is the strongest performer on held-out buildings under metrics resistant to class imbalance, leading macro-F1 and AUPRC, no method generalizes uniformly across datasets or relations.

item.title: Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Unlike on-policy distillation (OPD), which depends on a separate teacher model, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a single language model acting simultaneously as the student and

Unlike on-policy distillation (OPD), which depends on a separate teacher model, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a single language model acting simultaneously as the student and the teacher, with the teacher conditioned on privileged information. Despite this architectural simplicity, synchronous rollout generation dominates overall training time, creating a severe systems bottleneck when scaling OPSD. To address this, we introduce Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation (AsyncOPSD), a framework that decouples rollout generation from learner updates to improve training throughput. Since the teacher and student share parameters, AsyncOPSD eliminates the multi-model coordination overhead inherent to OPD architectures in asynchronous training. As the student policy evolves, buffered trajectories generated by older policies become stale, potentially degrading performance. To mitigate this, we introduce a distillation objective based on staleness-aware policy control and token-level entropy weighting. item.title: An Event-Driven System Architecture for a 15-Minute Urban Flood Digital Twin: A Hanoi Case Study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Flash floods in Hanoi submerge roads within minutes of heavy rain onset, yet public flood advisories remain retrospective. Hydrodynamic models could supply forward-looking depth guidance, bu

Flash floods in Hanoi submerge roads within minutes of heavy rain onset, yet public flood advisories remain retrospective. Hydrodynamic models could supply forward-looking depth guidance, but they are typically run offline for historical events, and prior studies have not evaluated whether physics-based simulation, spatial serving, and vehicle-aware routing can operate together within a fixed refresh cycle using a cloud solver and a single commodity server. This paper evaluates an end-to-end prototype of an automated flood digital twin designed to meet a 15-minute refresh cycle under data scarcity. The architecture organizes execution into decoupled, event-driven workflows that chain weather-gated 3Di simulations through hydraulic restart states, serve flood depths through a dual-track spatial layer, and publish road-edge depths via standardized output contracts. Evaluated on a 57-run storm replay in the My Dinh and Tay Mo sector of Hanoi driven by satellite rainfall estimates, every cycle completed within the 15-minute deadline, publishing a ready edge table at a median of 537 s after slot start. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are critical for adapting large models under resource-constrained settings. However, as mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, which offer eff

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are critical for adapting large models under resource-constrained settings. However, as mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, which offer efficient inference at massive parameter scales, gain increasing prevalence in the community, a critical gap arising from the lack of systematic recipes for applying PEFT to MoE models. To narrow this gap, we conduct a large-scale systematic study that investigates a set of essential design recipes, including which modules should be adapted, which granularity should be used to adapt MoE modules, which PEFT method to use, and to what extent should the load-balancing objective be used, across three MoE backbones on downstream tasks and general knowledge tasks. Our experiments yield several key insights. First, adapting MoE experts alone achieves the highest downstream performance with competitive general capability retention under a comparable parameter budget. Second, native expert-weight updates offer a better downstream--retention trade-off than adapters that bypass experts or entire MoE modules. item.title: An Analysis of Semantic and Spatio-Temporal Co-evolution for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Dynamic edge classification on text-attributed Web graphs, such as review networks, community forums, and news-derived knowledge graphs, requires high quality, adaptive semantic representati

Dynamic edge classification on text-attributed Web graphs, such as review networks, community forums, and news-derived knowledge graphs, requires high quality, adaptive semantic representations in the context of network evolution. Existing dynamic graph architectures typically initialize text feature vectors with pretrained language models and hold them static during training to preserve their semantic structure, forgoing the potential benefits of allowing them to co-evolve with network topology. In this work, we investigate the effects of enabling such co-evolution with a unified text-graph alignment framework that integrates a lightweight Transformer adapter to update token-level text representations via spatio-temporal gradients from a contrastive pretraining objective. To prevent detrimental semantic distortion, a language model maintenance objective anchors the evolving text embeddings to their original semantic structure. Evaluations on the Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark demonstrate that this anchored text-graph co-evolution consistently improves upon the edge classification performance of frozen-text baselines across diverse Web-related domains. item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Rollout decoding affects both which trajectories are used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and how many completion tokens are spent collecting them. We study whether

Rollout decoding affects both which trajectories are used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and how many completion tokens are spent collecting them. We study whether candidate-token support should remain fixed or widen during training in the context of rollout sampling efficiency. Our main schedule moves from top-K=10 to K=20 and then to full support as the attempted-token budget increases. In a 4B code-RLVR setting, the schedule has a higher interpolated 150M-token validation value than its matched fixed-K=10 continuation in all three runs, with a mean gain of $1.80{\pm}0.42$ points. The schedule also performs comparably to a separately trained fixed-K=20 baseline, the strongest fixed-support setting in our sweep. Follow-up experiments suggest that late widening to full support is the most promising variant, although the evidence remains noisy, and mixed-reward-group diagnostics do not clearly explain the gain. An exploratory single-run test replay yields identical point estimates for the schedule and fixed $K=10$. item.title: A Type System for Communication-Safe Hardware Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.PL　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Hardware components communicate through clock-cycle-sensitive protocols. Hardware Description Languages (HDLs), however, provide limited support for expressing these protocols or for checkin

Hardware components communicate through clock-cycle-sensitive protocols. Hardware Description Languages (HDLs), however, provide limited support for expressing these protocols or for checking that independently developed components agree on them. When components disagree, the composed design can perform unsynchronized exchanges or stop making progress. We call these failures communication-safety violations. Communication safety is therefore a global property, determined by interactions between multiple components. This makes it difficult to check modularly. This paper presents Pact, a typed extension of Anvil for modular verification of communication safety in synchronous hardware. Pact types describe message-passing, control-flow, and clock-cycle behaviour. Each component is checked against its type. Compatible types then guarantee that the components compose into a communication-safe system. Pact also supports incremental design. It can check a subsystem before the full system context is available. The check produces a summary type that captures the communication behaviour left for future compositions. item.title: A Theoretical Analysis of Environment-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection for Vision-Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Continual vision-language models (VLMs) encounter a stream of environments and must also reject inputs that do not belong to the environment at hand.

Continual vision-language models (VLMs) encounter a stream of environments and must also reject inputs that do not belong to the environment at hand. Class information from earlier environments can aid out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, yet existing detectors score each environment in isolation, and when previous environments help or hurt is theoretically unclear. We develop a theory of environment-aware OOD detection built on contribution scores, pairwise cosine expectations measuring how the image and text features of one environment align with those of another. We propose a cross-environment maximum-concept-matching (MCM) score with two terms: a primary term matching the test image against the current class texts, and a secondary term matching it against the class texts of a previous environment, weighted by the intra-modal alignment between the two environments. We prove that, under a positive environment transition and a bounded class-matching margin for OOD inputs, this score attains a false-positive rate no larger than that of the standard MCM detector at an adjusted threshold. item.title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Accurate multi-horizon photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential for grid stability, energy scheduling, and the efficient operation of PVbatterygrid systems.

Accurate multi-horizon photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting is essential for grid stability, energy scheduling, and the efficient operation of PVbatterygrid systems. However, existing models often fail to jointly capture short-term variability and long-term temporal patterns, while lacking unified multi-horizon capability and interpretability. To address these limitations, this study proposes a novel hybrid deep learning framework that integrates a Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and N-BEATS within an attention-based fusion architecture. The proposed model leverages TFT to learn short-term temporal dependencies and dynamic feature importance, while N-BEATS captures long-term trend and seasonal components through interpretable basis decomposition. An adaptive attention mechanism dynamically fuses both branches, enabling balanced multi-scale learning. The framework simultaneously generates forecasts for 30-minute, 2-hour, 6-hour, 12-hour, and 24-hour horizons within a single unified pipeline. The model is evaluated using multi-year real-world datasets from the Desert Knowledge Australia Solar Centre (DKASC). Experimental results demonstrate superior performance over statistical, mac…

item.title: A Hybrid GPU and Processing-Near-Memory Architecture with Shared DRAM for Efficient Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.AR　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 推理服务中 prefill（算力受限）与 decode（带宽受限）错配严重：合在一起互相干扰，而做 prefill-decode（PD）分离又导致资源利用不足——prefill 让显存带宽闲置，decode 让算力闲置。GPU SM 切分这类空间划分方案受限于"decode 仍需大量 SM 才能打满带宽"，留给 prefill 的算力随之被压缩，形成固有权衡。

方法 提出混合 PD 分离架构 DuoPD：把轻量近存计算（PNM）单元集成进 HBM 逻辑层。与以往依赖昂贵内部带宽扩展、且只卸载部分解码算子的 PIM/PNM 设计不同，DuoPD 借与 GPU 共享的 HBM 接口做带宽共享，让整个解码在 PNM 上执行，从而使算力受限的 prefill 与带宽受限的 decode 并发、干扰极小；配套紧凑 PNM 微架构、TSV 级带宽共享机制，以及面向 GPU-PNM 混合执行的分层数据映射。

关键数字 在服务器规模 LLM 上评测，端到端吞吐最高达到传统 PD 分离的 2.23 倍。

为什么值得看 PD 分离正被各推理框架广泛部署，"把解码整体搬到 HBM 逻辑层"给出了一个跳出 SM 切分死结的架构答案。

阅读原文
item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv/cs.AR　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 推理服务中 prefill（算力受限）与 decode（带宽受限）错配严重：合在一起互相干扰，而做 prefill-decode（PD）分离又导致资源利用不足——prefill 让显存带宽闲置，decode 让算力闲置。GPU SM 切分这类空间划分方案受限于"decode 仍需大量 SM 才能打满带宽"，留给 prefill 的算力随之被压缩，形成固有权衡。

方法 提出混合 PD 分离架构 DuoPD：把轻量近存计算（PNM）单元集成进 HBM 逻辑层。与以往依赖昂贵内部带宽扩展、且只卸载部分解码算子的 PIM/PNM 设计不同，DuoPD 借与 GPU 共享的 HBM 接口做带宽共享，让整个解码在 PNM 上执行，从而使算力受限的 prefill 与带宽受限的 decode 并发、干扰极小；配套紧凑 PNM 微架构、TSV 级带宽共享机制，以及面向 GPU-PNM 混合执行的分层数据映射。

关键数字 在服务器规模 LLM 上评测，端到端吞吐最高达到传统 PD 分离的 2.23 倍。

为什么值得看 PD 分离正被各推理框架广泛部署，"把解码整体搬到 HBM 逻辑层"给出了一个跳出 SM 切分死结的架构答案。

item.title: A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF

Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heur

Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual prog…

item.title: A 105 MS/s 4.18 nJ/inference 0.765 $\text{mm}^\text{2}$ Mixed-Signal Streaming ML Engine for Wireless Baseband in 12LP+ FinFET
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.AR　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 无线系统的实时一体化感知与通信（ISAC）需要一颗能持续吃下基带采样流的流式机器学习引擎。

方法 提出首个面向 ISAC 的流式机器学习引擎 SIXPPAC，集成两个 SAR ADC 与一个数字二值权重六层神经网络；0.765 mm² 的 12 nm FinFET 引擎把全部网络参数片上存储，因此无需外挂存储即可持续工作；用 AND 门代替 XNOR 门实现双极性内积。

关键数字 在 0.8 V 下以 105 MS/s 持续处理 8b I/Q 基带样本，每次推理能耗 4.18 nJ（0.42 POPS/W）；并在三个示例应用上验证了通用性。

为什么值得看 边缘唤醒类任务最关心的就是 nJ/次与是否要外挂存储，"参数全部片上"这个指标值得记下来。

item.title: 3D-MoE: Complementarity-Guided Hardware-Software Co-Design for MoE Decode on 3D-Stacked NMP
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-19　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE decode 内存受限且专家负载偏斜时变，3D 堆叠 DRAM 近存（NMP）提供所需带宽但 tile 化组织使负载均衡昂贵：EP 保局部性却热点失衡，分布式又弱局部性、增 NoC 流量——能否同时拿到局部性与均衡？

方法 观察到域特化路由带来跨解码步抵消的负载波动（专家互补性），提出 3D-MoE：离线一次性互补引导分组+局部感知映射建立组间粗均衡；残留热点由轻量协作内存网络（CMN）经本地广播路径把热专家权重流式搬一次；配合成本感知在线重映射抗负载漂移。

关键数字 平均 MoE 层较 EP 加速 4.63×，端到端吞吐较最强 NMP 基线提升 1.58×–1.86×，额外逻辑晶圆面积仅 2.11%。

为什么值得看 用"专家互补性"同时解开 3D 近存 MoE 的局部性-均衡死结，是近存计算服务 LLM 推理的代表作。

item.title: vLLM v0.32.0
item.description:
发表方：vLLM（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-18　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 vLLM v0.32.0 大版本发布，814 commits / 363 贡献者（其中 121 位新加入），重点铺开低比特 KV 缓存全架构。

要点 NVFP4 KV 缓存覆盖 SM8x/90/12x（含 XQA decode、Sparse attention）；GLM-5.x 在 SM100 上默认 FP8 KV 缓存；ROCm 引入 4-bit ultraquant KV；新增 POST /v1/systemone 结构化决策端点与通用 hf 工具/推理解析器；Model Runner V2 默认；多项安全修复。

关键数字 GLM-5.x FP8 KV 每 rank 显存占用减半、吞吐提升 2.3–5.5%（TTFT 增 7–11%）；GLM-5.3-Flash 在 SM90 上 fp8_ds_mla 输出吞吐最高 +31%；ROCm 4-bit ultraquant KV 密度约为 FP8 的 2×。

为什么值得看 vLLM 大版本是开源 LLM 推理栈演进的标志性事件；NVFP4、稀疏注意力、FP8 KV、ultraquant 几乎都是当下推理优化的主战场。

item.title: panvram: GPU-resident random access to a human pangenome cohort
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Repeatedly sampling short sequence windows from a human pangenome requires an access representation as well as compression. panvram stores each assembly as a reference-relative block archive

Repeatedly sampling short sequence windows from a human pangenome requires an access representation as well as compression. panvram stores each assembly as a reference-relative block archive and pools these archives on a GPU. For 558 haplotype assemblies, the default q4k representation occupies 16.642 GB of persistent pools including the decoded reference; a packed-reference, compact-directory representation occupies 11.634 GB. These quantities are not peak application memory. In the C1 experiment, default and fully compact forms delivered 743,271 and 736,762 windows/s; a separate public Colab run delivered 741,931 and 680,760 windows/s. All are batch API measurements and must not be pooled as repeated trials of an identical environment. Full-decoding checks compared reconstructed FASTA checksums with the manifest. On the CPU, the M6 shuffled-window workload at the same cohort cardinality reported 26 requests/s for AGC and 145,222 requests/s for refrel3 q4k. This comparison concerns one-thread requests of 4 KiB on the recorded warm-cache workload, not all genome-access patterns. AGC provides the smaller incremental archive: 5.40 MB/assembly versus 13.04 MB/assembly for refrel3 q16k…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: llama.cpp b11721
item.description:
发表方：llama.cpp（GitHub Releases）　发布：2026-10-18　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 llama.cpp b11721 把 qwen4exp 模型的 SCALE→SIGMOID→SCALE→hc_post 四内核链融合为单个 CUDA 内核。

要点 移植 Vulkan 上 PR #29520 的 HC_POST_GATE 融合：hc_combine 直接由原始权重构建 hc_post 的门控模板（2·sigmoid(inject/hc)），dsv4_hc_post_f32 新增 gated template 标记并从原始权重直接计算 scale_out·sigmoid(scale_in·p)，四内核变一内核。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体加速比。

为什么值得看 算子融合是 GPU 推理性能优化的关键路径之一；该 PR 在 qwen4exp 上展示的具体收益对同类 hybrid 架构模型有借鉴意义。

item.title: World Model Interpretability: From Decoding Representations to Understanding Latent Worlds
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Emerging Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are moving beyond representation learning towards latent world models that support prediction, planning, and control. Yet their late

Emerging Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are moving beyond representation learning towards latent world models that support prediction, planning, and control. Yet their latent worlds naturally lack a human-interpretable interface. In this Perspective, we argue that as JEPA latents become internal states for prediction and action, interpretability must move beyond what they encode to how latent variables interact, evolve, and causally drive prediction. To this end, we envision a four-stage research agenda, involving Ground, Structure, Verify, and Act, to guide this shift toward actionable latent-world understanding. Within our framework, existing JEPA interpretability efforts provide early evidence for Ground, while systematic analysis of latent structure, causal verification, and intervention remains largely unexplored. Overall, this Perspective aims to call for a broader latent-world interpretability agenda that shifts attention from decoding representations toward understanding, validating, and acting on latent worlds.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ViCoR: Estimating Visual Necessity via Counterfactual Residuals for Multimodal Medical Data Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Medical vision-language models often exhibit hidden stratification, where high overall performance masks failures on subtle visual findings and overlapping clinical conditions. We trace this

Medical vision-language models often exhibit hidden stratification, where high overall performance masks failures on subtle visual findings and overlapping clinical conditions. We trace this failure mode to modality imbalance during fine-tuning, where strong linguistic priors can suppress visually grounded learning and induce plausible but weakly grounded rationales. Existing data selection methods usually score image-text pairs as holistic units, without separating visually necessary samples from shortcut-solvable ones. To address this problem, we propose ViCoR, a counterfactual-residual-based data selection method for Med-VLM fine-tuning. ViCoR estimates visual necessity through image-dependent optimization residuals, calibrates the resulting scores with medical supervision compatibility, and constructs a diversity-aware fine-tuning subset. Across two backbones, four external generalization benchmarks, and one multi-disease robustness benchmark, ViCoR-selected 20\% subsets achieve the strongest average performance compared with full-data fine-tuning and selection baselines. Gradient-level analysis and perturbation audits further show that ViCoR enriches image-dependent training s…

item.title: UpLoop: Upcycling Large Language Models with Gated Loop
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Looped large language models trade parameter storage for recurrent computation, but most are trained from scratch. In practice, pretraining with looped depth is expensive, making post-traini

Looped large language models trade parameter storage for recurrent computation, but most are trained from scratch. In practice, pretraining with looped depth is expensive, making post-training upcycling of a pretrained non-looped LLM an attractive alternative. We introduce \textbf{UpLoop}, a post-training recipe based on \emph{layer-wise} recurrence. Instead of looping a whole model or a middle block, UpLoop loops each selected layer locally, preserving the pretrained depth hierarchy and avoiding feature-space mismatch. To make loop execution useful, we add hidden-wise gates on the attention and MLP residual branches, so later loops act as progressive refinements rather than redundant rewrites. Empirically, UpLoop breaks the commonly observed saturation at two loops ($R=2$) in prior looped models. Starting from Qwen3-4B Base and applying SFT, UpLoop improves the average accuracy across 20 benchmarks by 6.17\% at $R=3$. We use $R=3$ as the main setting for the best accuracy--cost trade-off, while both native and extrapolated $R=4$ yield further gains.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Triple Overlap in Pipelined Krylov Methods on Multi-GPU Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

We introduce a novel triple-overlap implementation of the pipelined preconditioned conjugate gradient (Pipe-PCG) and pipelined stabilized biconjugate gradient (Pipe-BiCGStab) solvers, method

We introduce a novel triple-overlap implementation of the pipelined preconditioned conjugate gradient (Pipe-PCG) and pipelined stabilized biconjugate gradient (Pipe-BiCGStab) solvers, methods widely used in scientific applications. By leveraging a collective communication library, our approach extends conventional computation-communication overlap to concurrently execute collective operations, irregular P2P communication, and compute kernels, enabling computation-communication-communication overlap across multiple GPUs. We evaluate the design on the MareNostrum 5 (H100) and Leonardo (A100) supercomputers, comparing against PETSc and the state-of-the-art two-stream NCCL implementation using SuiteSparse matrices and three massive instances scaled up to 512 GPUs. The three-stream design outperforms the two-stream baseline on every instance, with the margin widening from 2-6% at 4 GPUs to 18-47% at 64 GPUs. item.title: Transformers Learn Two Competing Sorting Algorithms, and Only One Length-Generalizes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

We show that two-layer transformers trained to near-zero loss on a sorting task converge to one of two mechanistically distinct solution classes depending on their initialization.

We show that two-layer transformers trained to near-zero loss on a sorting task converge to one of two mechanistically distinct solution classes depending on their initialization. One solution class consists of solutions that do not use the second attention layer to sort, but also fail to length-generalize. The other, which uses both attention layers, length-generalizes perfectly, despite only being trained to sort sequences of a fixed length. By carefully choosing the weight initialization, we demonstrate that we can steer the model toward learning one solution or the other. We identify input types that are rare at the training length but increasingly common at longer sequence lengths as a source of this disparity in length-generalization, and find that layer-wise specialization of the second class of solutions allows them to handle these rare sequences more accurately. In the second class, we discover a mechanism by which the second layer attention can use the contextual information gathered by the first layer attention to reduce its search space. item.title: T-MUON: Tensorizing Muon via t-SVD for Large Language Model Pre-training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Muon has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large language model pretraining by exploiting matrix structure through polar orthogonalization. However, it processes each parameter matr

Muon has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large language model pretraining by exploiting matrix structure through polar orthogonalization. However, it processes each parameter matrix independently, whereas recent tensor-aware extensions of Muon jointly update groups of eligible matrix parameters through matrix unfoldings. In contrast, we propose T-MUON, a t-SVD-based generalization that groups structurally related Transformer gradients into third-order tensors and defines the corresponding Muon-style update directly through the $M$-transform. We show that the exact T-MUON update is a steepest-descent direction under the $\star_M$-spectral norm and establish a convergence guarantee. Across GPT-2-style and LLaMA-style models from 51M to 1.3B parameters trained on FineWeb and FineWeb-Edu, head-wise T-MUON with the identity transform consistently achieves lower validation perplexity than AdamW, Muon, and variants using DFT, DCT, or DST transforms. These gains persist in additional experiments with longer context lengths and larger token budgets, although the preferred tensorization mode varies across settings.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: StreamAhead: Real-Time Streaming Video Question Answering via Adaptive Precomputation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Real-time streaming video question answering with vision-language models must answer queries that arrive at any time with low latency while sustaining the video-processing rate required by t

Real-time streaming video question answering with vision-language models must answer queries that arrive at any time with low latency while sustaining the video-processing rate required by the application. Existing systems construct key-value (KV) caches for the entire video as it arrives, although a query typically uses only a few of the preceding frames as evidence. This highlights a fundamental trade-off: performing more computation as video arrives reduces query-time computation but can increase processing lag, whereas deferring computation can increase the video-processing rate but requires additional query-time computation for retrieved content. We present StreamAhead, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this trade-off through adaptive precomputation: dynamically controlling how much computation to complete for each video segment before a query arrives. StreamAhead encodes video segments independently and lets each remain at a different representation level, from inexpensive visual features to costly KV caches, completing KV caches only for the retrieved segments when a query arrives. StreamAhead profiles offline the cost of advancing a segment to each representation …

item.title: Shallow Probes Are Sufficient for Near-Oracle Personalization Depth Allocation in Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Rather than proposing a new federated optimizer, we study whether a small client-specific measurement budget can support cost-aware personalization-depth decisions under a utility that trade

Rather than proposing a new federated optimizer, we study whether a small client-specific measurement budget can support cost-aware personalization-depth decisions under a utility that trades Macro-F1 against deployment cost. Exhaustive evaluation of six depths defines an offline oracle that is not deployable. We audit the Probe Sufficiency Hypothesis: three shallow probes (P0--P2) may contain most decision-relevant information for approaching that oracle. FedPBA is a secondary learned instantiation for deep-action extrapolation. On CIFAR-10/100 and patient-disjoint PTB-XL (45 sessions; 900 clients; 2700 evaluations; GroupKFold), training-free greedy probing achieves regret 0.0071 and 98.3 percent oracle recovery, beating metadata-only policies and FedPBA (0.0110 / 97.3 percent). Aggregate shallow-best versus oracle correlation is 0.9818 but falls to 0.578 on deep-oracle rows; PTB-XL deep-oracle cases remain a high-regret boundary without a validated escalation gate.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Ride, Raise, or Wake: A Theory of Light-Thread Placement on Multi-Tier Processors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.PF　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

hones and laptops now mix several kinds of cores, and each kind sits in its own voltage and clock domain. When a light thread arrives, should it run beside heavy threads on a fast cluster th

hones and laptops now mix several kinds of cores, and each kind sits in its own voltage and clock domain. When a light thread arrives, should it run beside heavy threads on a fast cluster that is already awake, or wake a cluster of efficient cores? We answer with three costs. A thread can \emph{ride} an awake domain at the voltage other threads hold, \emph{raise} that voltage for everyone, or \emph{wake} a sleeping domain and pay its fixed power. From these costs follows a simple rule: ride while the thread's demand is below $r^*=\Phi/(e_h-e_l)$, the fixed power of the cluster it would wake over the gap in energy per operation; otherwise wake the smallest tier that can serve it. The best tier is not monotone in demand: tiny threads ride high, medium threads wake a low tier, heavy threads go high again. Two common designs err on opposite sides of the rule: grouping a light thread with the heavy threads of its application overpays above the threshold, and an energy model without idle costs overpays below it. In a model with five tiers, grouping costs 80 to 145\% more energy than the rule, and more as tiers are added. Measurements on an Apple M6 anchor the parameters.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Reinforcement learning on the EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment benchmark: diagnosing over-commitment and guiding MILP with learned policies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP).

Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In the first study of RL on the 51-generator, 72-hour benchmark of the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition, we trace this gap to the agents' own exploration, close most of it, and show that the resulting policy can accelerate an exact solver. In every configuration tested, Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) and an action-branching Deep Q-Network (DQN) trained from scratch committed about twice the units of a thermal-only MILP optimum, at 39-64% higher cost, whereas a merit-order rule came within 1.6-7% (10-24% when unserved energy is priced). When each unit's decision is sampled independently, spare units insure against random de-commitments. Consistent with this, injecting exploration noise during fine-tuning enlarged a lean policy's fleet, a reward without shaping terms did not remove the over-commitment, and under their training noise the agents outperformed the rule subjected to comparable noise. item.title: Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Modeling limit order book (LOB) dynamics is central to market forecasting and execution-strategy evaluation. While diffusion models achieve strong empirical performance, existing LOB snapsho

Modeling limit order book (LOB) dynamics is central to market forecasting and execution-strategy evaluation. While diffusion models achieve strong empirical performance, existing LOB snapshot models typically lack a learned recurrent encoder and formal statistical guarantees. We introduce LOBGrad, a conditional DDPM framework for probabilistic LOB forecasting that combines an autoregressive RNN encoder with a diffusion-based generator. In particular, we establish an excess-risk oracle inequality for the one-step DDPM noise-prediction objective under exponential mixing and regularity assumptions. We further show that, under contractive dynamics, the dependence on the conditioning-window length can be reduced to a dependence on the latent-state dimension. Experiments on BTC/USDT, GOOGL, and META show that LOBGrad improves on its encoder-free diffusion ablation across all reported queue metrics and obtains competitive results against other baselines. It also reproduces the key stylized facts of LOB microstructure, and yields reasonably calibrated queue-based predictive intervals. A stylized downstream task illustrates the potential value of the generated forecasts.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Polynomial Learning of Positive ReLU Networks under Gaussian Inputs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

We study positive, bias-free, one-hidden-layer ReLU networks under standard Gaussian inputs. We obtain algorithms with polynomial sample and real-arithmetic complexity, without separation or

We study positive, bias-free, one-hidden-layer ReLU networks under standard Gaussian inputs. We obtain algorithms with polynomial sample and real-arithmetic complexity, without separation or conditioning assumptions on the hidden directions. When the conditional label mean is a width-$k$ network with total output weight at most one, the learner achieves squared prediction error $\varepsilon$ with output width at most $k+\min\{k,d\}$ and complexity linear in one plus the residual second moment. For arbitrary labels with bounded second moment, we obtain a positive ReLU network of width $O(k\log(2/\varepsilon))$. Its risk is bounded by the irreducible noise variance plus $Ck^3\log^{9/2}(2k/\varepsilon)$ times the squared distance of the conditional mean to the target class, plus $\varepsilon$. The proofs combine implicit Hermite moments, orthogonal tensor-train compression, and a direction decoder whose probability of returning a direction far from every atom is bounded linearly in the compression and estimation errors. Exact Gaussian localization refines the resulting direction covers. In the agnostic setting, a cone-constrained convex program with a scale-dependent penalty produces …

A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels.

A guardrail classifier is reported as if unsafe were a property of text. It is not: it is a property of a policy, and the policy enters the model through its labels. We exploit an accident of an industrial deployment in which the same ~53k prompts were labelled twice, under two operational definitions ("is this a request for harmful content?" and "would a moderator block this?"), and used to train ten guardrail arms sharing architecture, codebase and optimiser family, at two model scales. First, the guardrail's own training corpus already contained the benchmarks: JailbreakBench-benign is 88% and OR-Bench-hard 82% present in the training pools, two over-refusal benchmarks, the kind a guardrail reports to argue it does not over-block. Everything below is decontaminated. Second, safety benchmarks stratify sharply by how much of their score is decided by the label definition rather than by the model: with architecture and optimiser fixed, the range across the ten arms is 0.99 on HarmBench-copyright and 0.043 on WildGuard-benign, a 23x spread. item.title: PlaneZip: Lossless Bit-Plane Compression of Training Activations Offloaded over PCIe
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 显存预算下的训练依赖张量重物化：被逐出的激活要么 swap 到主机内存，要么丢弃重算。可 GPU 算力增速已超 PCIe 带宽，MegTaiChi 这类按完整传输时间计费的成本模型规划器几乎不 swap；而利用空闲链路时间的 swap 也只能塞下很小一部分激活。

方法 提出 PlaneZip：在拷贝路径上压缩 swap 张量，并让规划器围绕压缩来规划。编码器对每个 128 字节块，在零值、delta bit-plane、bit-plane 与新增的零掩码 bit-plane 编码之间取最小者；逐张量预测器复用上一轮迭代的压缩率；规划器按压缩后的传输时间预算链路时间。

关键数字 在五个模型真实训练数据采集的激活上，BF16 压缩 1.71 倍、FP32 压缩 1.39 倍（几何平均），而零值压缩只有 1.18 倍与 1.20 倍；在 PCIe 3.0 消费级 GPU 与 PCIe 4.0 数据中心 GPU、激活显存减半的轨迹驱动仿真下，相对无压缩的带宽感知规划器分别降低 47% 与 31% 的重物化开销，相对 MegTaiChi 成本模型降低 73% 与 54%，预估引擎面积 0.036 mm²。

为什么值得看 激活的冗余远不止是零——按 bit-plane 挖出 1.7 倍后，"GPU 比 PCIe 快"这个前提下的 swap 才重新变得值得做。

item.title: PRECOCIAL: Pretraining with Code Curriculums via Iterative Search for Accelerated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Fully synthetic pretraining data generated by symbolic programs can bootstrap downstream training on naturalistic tasks, such as language modeling, but the generating programs have so far be

Fully synthetic pretraining data generated by symbolic programs can bootstrap downstream training on naturalistic tasks, such as language modeling, but the generating programs have so far been designed by hand. We introduce PRECOCIAL, a method for automatically optimizing programs that generate synthetic pretraining data. Starting from an initial generator program, an LLM iteratively rewrites the program, and each rewrite is scored by pretraining a randomly-initialized transformer on its data and fine-tuning it on the downstream task. Because every score requires training, PRECOCIAL keeps a single network for the entire search, continuing its pretraining for each accepted program instead of training a new network per candidate, making it significantly more efficient. On four language and code datasets, at a fixed fine-tuning budget, optimized programs reach lower perplexity than hand-designed curricula, published procedural generators, random program mutation and the program the LLM writes in the first iteration of the search, and reach the same perplexity as the hand-designed curricula with 9-33% fewer fine-tuning steps. item.title: PACT: NVFP4 Data-Flow LoRA Fine-Tuning on Consumer GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 消费级 GPU 上微调语言模型受算力与显存双重限制：LoRA 虽减少了可训练参数与优化器状态，冻结投影依然昂贵，而为反向保留的激活又常常主导显存占用。

方法 提出 LoRA 微调系统 PACT：用原生 NVFP4 GEMM 加速冻结投影，同时降低量化/反量化开销并限制量化误差；复用量化后的 RMSNorm 输出、以 NVFP4 保存 gate/up 激活用于反向，以压低激活显存；前向非线性保留 BF16 输入以控数值误差，用改造到 NVFP4 刻度与量化激活的 GPTQ 离线校准冻结权重；融合非线性 kernel 并缓存前反向权重布局以减少量化反量化开销。

关键数字 在 16 GB 的 RTX 5080 上跨多个模型与任务评测，显存占用更低、LoRA 微调更快且精度具竞争力，使资源受限的消费级硬件也能做模型适配（摘要未列具体加速倍数）。

为什么值得看 把 4-bit 格式用在冻结权重与激活这类"乘得多却不更新"的地方，而非全链路量化，是小显存卡微调 LLM 的可复制套路。

item.title: Off-Tree Forwarding for Accelerating Broadcasts from Arbitrary Sources in Plumtree
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Overlay broadcast is fundamental to large-scale distributed systems, enabling messages to be disseminated to all participants. Plumtree is a well-established protocol that embeds a spanning

Overlay broadcast is fundamental to large-scale distributed systems, enabling messages to be disseminated to all participants. Plumtree is a well-established protocol that embeds a spanning tree in a gossip overlay: payloads are disseminated along tree links, while non-tree links support recovery and optimization. However, because the tree is constructed from the first broadcast, it is optimized for the initial source and can introduce long detours for broadcasts originating at other nodes, particularly leaf nodes. To address this limitation, we propose probabilistic exuding, an off-tree forwarding mechanism in which nodes near the source additionally forward payloads over their non-tree links with a specified probability. Exuded messages use a dedicated message type and do not participate in tree construction or repair, leaving the shared tree unchanged. Simulations on a 1000-node random regular overlay show that, for randomly selected sources and a representative parameter setting, the proposed method reduces the 95th-percentile delivery latency by approximately 40% relative to Plumtree. This closes approximately 92% of the latency gap between Plumtree and flooding while sending …

EEG analysis and decoding underpin brain-computer interfaces, cognitive assessment, and sleep monitoring. item.title: Multi-site Learning for Forecasting Day-Ahead Wind-Power Production for Onshore Wind Farms in Great Britain with Deep Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Accurate day-ahead wind-power production forecasting is increasingly important for energy system operations, market activity and balancing Great Britain's grid as wind generation grows. In t

Accurate day-ahead wind-power production forecasting is increasingly important for energy system operations, market activity and balancing Great Britain's grid as wind generation grows. In this study, we train multi-site deep neural networks (DNNs) using pooled historical production and reanalysis weather data from 88 onshore wind Balancing Mechanism Units (BMUs). Forecasts are produced at 09:00 UK time for the following midnight-to-midnight delivery day, matching NESO's operational day-ahead forecasting schedule. We use reanalysis weather as future covariates during training and numerical weather prediction (NWP) forecasts during inference, extending training beyond the available historical NWP archive. Our multi-site recurrent neural network outperforms site-specific RNNs and a multi-site XGBoost model, while processing the full future-weather trajectory for the forecast horizon further improves accuracy relative to hour-aligned approaches. item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

A spatial excursion set identifies where a field exceeds a threshold. With incomplete and noisy observations, inner and outer confidence regions quantify uncertainty in its spatial extent th

A spatial excursion set identifies where a field exceeds a threshold. With incomplete and noisy observations, inner and outer confidence regions quantify uncertainty in its spatial extent through lower and upper bounds at a specified confidence level. Constructing these regions requires repeated conditional simulations accounting for joint spatial uncertainty, making dense covariance factorization and simulation major computational bottlenecks. We present a GPU-accelerated framework that combines adaptive tile-based mixed-precision arithmetic with distributed task execution to accelerate universal kriging, prediction-uncertainty estimation, conditional Gaussian simulation, and confidence region calibration. In our parallel mixed-precision simulation workflow, triangular matrix-matrix multiplication (TRMM) inherits the adaptive precision layout of the Cholesky factor and uses FP16 simulation operands, while covariance scaling and compensating operand rescaling accommodate the numerical range of reduced precision arithmetic. item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to accumulate past experiences for continual adaptation. However, effectively reusing memory requires accurately assess

Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to accumulate past experiences for continual adaptation. However, effectively reusing memory requires accurately assessing its value, as retrieved experiences may become unreliable when transferred across task contexts. Despite its importance, memory valuation remains largely underexplored, with existing methods relying on historical retrieval success rates that overlook the context dependency of memory usefulness and the varying reliability of estimates under different amounts of evidence. Inspired by the Bayesian brain hypothesis, we propose BEAM (Bayesian-style Evolutionary Agentic Memory), a framework that reformulates memory value evaluation as a parameterized cognitive inference process, where memory value is represented as a context-conditioned dynamic belief rather than a passive historical statistic. Specifically, BEAM infers memory value beliefs from current task contexts and continuously calibrates them using execution feedback as empirical evidence, transforming memory from passive storage into an adaptive cognitive mechanism for continual self-evolution. item.title: MOSAIC: Multi-Objective Search for Allocating Inference Cache Across LLM Decoder Layers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

The Key-Value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck of long-context LLM inference. Token eviction methods such as SnapKV, H2O, AdaKV and L2Norm shrink it, but they give every transformer

The Key-Value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck of long-context LLM inference. Token eviction methods such as SnapKV, H2O, AdaKV and L2Norm shrink it, but they give every transformer layer the same budget, although layers differ in which tokens they need. We present MOSAIC, a multi-objective neural architecture search that learns per-layer KV-cache budgets for any eviction method. One search maps the trade-off between average budget and task score; its best allocation transfers to every target budget without further search, and an optional budget-constrained search refines it. Across four eviction methods on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, MOSAIC beats uniform allocation in 146 of 154 (task, method, budget) settings, by up to +48 points on RULER and +11.9 on LongBench (LCC). On both models, it reaches the score of uniform allocation with up to 4x less KV cache (75% smaller). Against EvolKV, MOSAIC explores a ~10^40 x larger search space with 4x fewer evaluations and 18% fewer GPU-hours per budget, and scores higher in 5 of 6 settings. The learned allocations consistently favour a small set of middle layers.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: MLFont: Machine Learning-Driven Font Subsetting and Range-Compact Unicode-Range Slicing for Low-Latency Web Typography
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

CSS3 @font-face rules with unicode-range descriptors partition web fonts into downloadable slices. While Latin fonts need ~20 KB in WOFF2, Pan-European (LGC) and East Asian (CJK) fonts conta

CSS3 @font-face rules with unicode-range descriptors partition web fonts into downloadable slices. While Latin fonts need ~20 KB in WOFF2, Pan-European (LGC) and East Asian (CJK) fonts contain 2,297-30,759 codepoints (158 KB-5.9 MB in WOFF2), where heuristic partitioning causes unused-glyph downloads, high HTTP RTT, CSS bloat, or missing-glyph fallbacks. We present MLFont, a machine learning and optimization framework that learns font slicing strategies from corpora via three stages: (1) a Zipfian High-Frequency Tier (most) isolating top-frequency codepoints; (2) a Latent Co-Occurrence Topic Tier using Online Variational Bayes LDA (Online LDA) or a Deep Neural Network Topic Model (DNNTM) with Shannon Entropy Difference Loss and Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization; and (3) a Memetic Range-Compact Genetic Algorithm (GA) with Potts-Viterbi dynamic programming and island bridging that minimizes topic discrepancy and CSS fragmentation. item.title: Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-18　分类：论文PDF

Catastrophic forgetting in sequential deep learning arises from a fixed-capacity architectural constraint: parameter updates encoding new tasks perturb weight subspaces supporting prior repr

Catastrophic forgetting in sequential deep learning arises from a fixed-capacity architectural constraint: parameter updates encoding new tasks perturb weight subspaces supporting prior representations. We introduce the Knowledge Fusion Network (KFN), which mitigates the stability-plasticity trade-off in class-incremental learning through novelty-gated structural expansion rather than parameter negotiation within a shared capacity budget. KFN decouples task acquisition from knowledge consolidation: each incoming task is learned in an isolated lightweight specialist network (2.8M parameters) and integrated into the global model via a Structural Fusion Module that allocates dedicated channel capacity conditioned on a quantitative novelty score. Dual structural isolation--channel-space separation with temporally phased gradient unfreezing--protects consolidated knowledge. On ten-task Split CIFAR-100, KFN achieves 11.94% minimum task accuracy and 71.16% task-10 accuracy, whereas shared-parameter baselines degrade severely: LwF to 9.07% average accuracy (0.00% min), Replay++ to 8.91% (85.08% forgetting), and Replay to 16.21% (73.44% forgetting); KFN's forgetting (57.92%) is 15.5 pp lowe…
