item.title: Contrastive Adversarial Training for Robust Graph Neural Networks under Label Poisoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-17　分类：论文PDF

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are effective for modeling relational data but are vulnerable to label poisoning, where a small number of corrupted training labels can propagate errors across t

Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are effective for modeling relational data but are vulnerable to label poisoning, where a small number of corrupted training labels can propagate errors across the graph via message passing. Despite this risk, defenses against label poisoning remain underexplored: existing methods are primarily designed for label noise and often rely on robust losses or heuristic data cleaning that fail to distinguish adversarial poisoning from naturally hard examples. In this paper, we propose CoLAT (Contrastive Label-flipping for Adversarial Training), a novel contrastive adversarial training framework tailored for robust node classification on graphs. The core of our approach is a structure-aware detection model that uses contrastive learning to identify label-structure inconsistencies. Unlike prior contrastive methods that focus on representation learning, CoLAT leverages contrastive embeddings to select high-risk nodes that guide adversarial label-flipping during training. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are effective for modeling relational data but are vulnerable to label poisoning, where a small number of corrupted training labels can propagate errors across the graph via message passing. Despite this risk, defenses against label poisoning remain underexplored: existing methods are primarily designed for label noise and often rely on robust losses or heuristic data cleaning that fail to distinguish adversarial poisoning from naturally hard examples. In this paper, we propose CoLAT (Contrastive Label-flipping for Adversarial Training), a novel contrastive adversarial training framework tailored for robust node classification on graphs. The core of our approach is a structure-aware detection model that uses contrastive learning to identify label-structure inconsistencies. Unlike prior contrastive methods that focus on representation learning, CoLAT leverages contrastive embeddings to select high-risk nodes that guide adversarial label-flipping during training. item.title: CARTA: Self-Supervised Reusable Transaction Embeddings via Heterogeneous Tokenization and Cross-Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-17　分类：论文PDF

Acquiring fraud labels for payment transactions is expensive and inconsistent across tasks, and high-cardinality identifiers such as merchant names make one-hot feature pipelines infeasible

Acquiring fraud labels for payment transactions is expensive and inconsistent across tasks, and high-cardinality identifiers such as merchant names make one-hot feature pipelines infeasible at scale. We present CARTA, a self-supervised encoder that learns a compact 16-dim embedding from raw transactions without labels; the frozen embedding is then reused for label-efficient fraud probing and exploratory unsupervised risk stratification without retraining the encoder. CARTA uses type-specific projections with learned embedding tables for high-cardinality identifiers, trained with token excision and InfoNCE contrastive loss. On IEEE-CIS, its linear probe at 1% of labels exceeds a raw-feature probe at 100%; on IBM TabFormer (2M rows), its frozen embedding reaches GBDT AUPRC 0.508, above frequency encoding (0.411) and the merchant-dropping baseline (0.022), though fully-supervised CatBoost is stronger. CARTA is a label-free, reusable representation that complements task-specific supervised models.

item.title: AdamPM: Memory-Efficient LLM Optimization via Moment Pooling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-17　分类：论文PDF

Adam is widely used for training large language models (LLMs) owing to its strong optimization performance and training stability, but its element-wise estimation for the first and second mo

Adam is widely used for training large language models (LLMs) owing to its strong optimization performance and training stability, but its element-wise estimation for the first and second moments incur substantial memory overhead. Although numerous memory-efficient optimizers have been proposed, many incur additional computational overhead or require additional tuning of hyperparameters. Consequently, Adam remains a dominant and reliable choice for LLM pre-training. We propose AdamPM (Adam with Pooled Moments), a simple and memory-efficient variant of Adam that groups adjacent moment entries along the row or column dimension and represents each group by a single shared mean. AdamPM can well inherit Adam's hyperparameter settings and is readily integrated into existing Adam optimizer implementations, with less memory overhead. We systematically investigate pooling of both first and second moment estimates and identify second moment pooling as the effective design. With a group size of $s$, AdamPM reduces second moment memory to $1/s$ of the original requirement. item.title: A Symmetry-Matching Approach to Blind-Spot Reduction in Sparse Autoencoders
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-17　分类：论文PDF

Language models can treat semantically distinct inputs as interchangeable at the representation level, creating blind spots that standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not target. I

Language models can treat semantically distinct inputs as interchangeable at the representation level, creating blind spots that standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not target. In safety-critical settings such as clinical dosage extraction, legal clause interpretation, or financial amount verification, such failures can propagate silently into downstream decisions. We study this problem as one of feature-basis orientation. Building on a symmetry-matching view from algebraic error-detection theory, we add a differentiable $V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$ regularisation term to SAE training that penalises uneven perturbation response within a specified family. Across GPT-2, Gemma 2, and Qwen 2.5, a frozen multi-seed evaluation shows that $V$-regularisation raises both relative and absolute lower-tail responses while reducing response-profile imbalance, with no material general-text reconstruction degradation. JumpReLU and minimum description length (MDL) objectives remain close to the Standard SAE profile under the same protocol. item.title: A Multi-Step Inertial ADMM Algorithm for Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-17　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning has recently emerged as an important paradigm for large-scale distributed model training, which can be naturally formulated as a class of distributed learning problems. Th

Federated learning has recently emerged as an important paradigm for large-scale distributed model training, which can be naturally formulated as a class of distributed learning problems. The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is a widely used approach for solving such problems. However, its practical performance is often hindered by significant communication overhead and system heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose a multi-step inertial ADMM algorithm, called MiFedADMM, for federated learning. The proposed method leverages multiple historical iterates on the server side to construct a higher-order extrapolation after each aggregation to accelerate the convergence behavior. Under mild assumptions, we establish convergence results for the single-step variant of the proposed method and derive an O(1/K) convergence rate. Numerical experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and improved performance of the proposed method compared with existing approaches.

item.title: qGAMMA: A Framework for Optimal DNN Mapping on Multi-Precision Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：通用空间加速器支持多种定点/浮点精度，混合精度 DNN 该怎么映射才能最小化目标指标——能否有一个统一的探索与优化框架？

方法：qGAMMA 用领域专用遗传算法 + 基于硬件综合结果的分析性能模型，遍历映射与加速器配置设计空间，最小化目标指标。

关键数字：在多个 DNN 工作负载上的广泛评估显示，qGAMMA 能给出性能、能效与资源利用间的更优权衡（具体数字详见原文图表）。

为什么值得看：做混合精度映射与加速器设计选型的统一工具，把"试–错"变成可搜索的设计空间。

原文：qGAMMA: A Framework for Optimal DNN Mapping on Multi-Precision Accelerators

item.title: Who Plans, Who Edits? Verified, Cost-Aware Division of Labor for LLM-Driven Analog Layout Repair
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.AR　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Language-model agents can repair analog layouts when sign-off tools check every edit, but which model should plan a repair, which should edit it, and at what cost remain open questions. In o

Language-model agents can repair analog layouts when sign-off tools check every edit, but which model should plan a repair, which should edit it, and at what cost remain open questions. In our tool-grounded repair agent, models only choose bounded layout operators; sign-off tools rerun each task's contract checks after every edit, so failing layouts are never accepted. On layout-versus-schematic (LVS), design-rule checking (DRC), and post-layout repairs of three designs (a production high-voltage digital-to-analog converter (DAC), a 5-V oscillator, and a SKY130 operational transconductance amplifier (OTA)) with six tier-matched models from two vendors, 182 blind runs show that cheap models execute plans but rarely succeed alone (the cheapest model: 1 of 11 runs alone, 16 of 17 under a flagship planner; p < 0.001), cheap planners fail more often, and no fixed assignment is cheapest on every task. We propose a learning controller that selects models for each role and the escalation order from the first tool evaluation and updates Bayesian estimates after every attempt. item.title: What Remains Without Test Labels? Re-evaluating a Graph-Level Anomaly Detection Benchmark
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Graph-level anomaly detectors are trained only on normal graphs, yet benchmarks may use test labels for model selection. We examine whether UB-GOLD results reused by later papers support lab

Graph-level anomaly detectors are trained only on normal graphs, yet benchmarks may use test labels for model selection. We examine whether UB-GOLD results reused by later papers support label-free detection. We audit UB-GOLD and 14 GLAD code bases, re-run 21 detectors on UB-GOLD's folds under selection rules with and without test labels, and evaluate sensitivity to known structural changes. Test labels select checkpoints in UB-GOLD's shared training loop and checkpoints or hyperparameters in 8 of the 14 code bases. UB-GOLD also evaluates its kernel baselines against misaligned labels. Across nine datasets, selecting checkpoints by test AUROC adds an average of 5.12 AUROC points [3.97, 6.24] for the 12 UB-GOLD detectors relative to the final checkpoint and 4.13 [3.32, 4.79] relative to held-out normal graphs. In a post hoc permutation analysis with no truly better checkpoint, picking the best of noisy test evaluations still yields a gain more than half as large as the one observed against the final checkpoint. Configurations tuned on test labels score a further 1.53 points [0.64, 2.42] above repository defaults, a gap that mixes the value of test labels with that of tuning itself. …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Transformer Programs (TP) (Friedman et al., 2023) constrain a Transformer's architecture so that its learned computation can be extracted as readable Python code.

Transformer Programs (TP) (Friedman et al., 2023) constrain a Transformer's architecture so that its learned computation can be extracted as readable Python code. TP expose learned computations, but token accuracy can hide incorrect complete answers. In this work, we examine how program inspection provides insights beyond accuracy scores and helps guide training. We first evaluated TP on nine algorithmic tasks. We compared token accuracy with accuracy on complete output sequences and checked for failures missed by sampled tests. Further, we assessed training data improvements informed by program inspection and failure analysis, finding gains in sequence accuracy on several tasks. We examined a counting task where a program achieved 100% accuracy on sampled test sequences but failed on another input using the symbols and lengths allowed during training. The program counted correctly, but the required answer was missing from its output labels. item.title: Untrained CNN and coefficient-space regularization for joint reconstruction in photoacoustic tomography
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

The joint reconstruction of the initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed in photoacoustic tomography from boundary measurements is considered.

The joint reconstruction of the initial pressure and spatially varying sound speed in photoacoustic tomography from boundary measurements is considered. A regularized data-driven framework is proposed in which the unknown fields are represented in finite-dimensional wavelet spaces and fixed nonlinear features generated by an untrained convolutional neural network (CNN) are used to reconstruct the initial-pressure coefficients through Tikhonov-regularized least squares. A learned coefficient-space prior is subsequently used to infer the squared sound-speed coefficients. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate reconstruction on held-out data and strong generalization to previously unseen phantom geometries. The frozen reconstruction map also remains stable under measurement noise not represented during training, with only minor changes in reconstruction accuracy for noise levels up to $10\%$. In comparison with the supervised trained-CNN approach considered in this work, the untrained representation yields substantially smaller reconstruction errors while requiring approximately one-sixth of the computational time. These results demonstrate that fixed random convolutional features…

item.title: Understanding KV Residency in Production-Scale Agentic LLM Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Agentic large language model (LLM) applications turn one user request into a sequence of model and tool calls over a growing context.

Agentic large language model (LLM) applications turn one user request into a sequence of model and tool calls over a growing context. Retaining this context's key-value (KV) state in GPU memory lets later calls reuse it instead of recomputing it, but at fleet scale this needs substantial memory. We characterize four production Microsoft M365 workload traces (Deep Research, Enterprise Assistant, Coding Agent and Enterprise Chat) spanning more than 121 million model calls. In Deep Research, the application issues 89% of model calls and the median context grows from about 10K to 68K tokens by the 30th call. About 80% of context tokens are served from the prefix cache. With the public Llama-2-70B KV layout standing in for confidential models, one 99th-percentile Deep Research session exceeds the 80 GB HBM of an NVIDIA H100, and holding all live sessions at their peak needs an estimated 501.8 TB of HBM, although inference occupies only 5.6% of that retention time. Trace-driven replay shows that a one-hour idle cap cuts this ceiling by 3.6x while raising the share of calls that recompute context only from 4.07% to 4.53%. Under tighter budgets, eviction alone is insufficient: at one tenth…

item.title: TriRouter: Sparse-to-Dense Electrode-Space Routing for Robust EEG Motor Imagery Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces require reliable decoding from multichannel EEG, but practical acquisition often yields sparse or corrupted electrode montages.

Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces require reliable decoding from multichannel EEG, but practical acquisition often yields sparse or corrupted electrode montages. We propose TriRouter, an electrode-space routing framework with discriminative-preservation, mask-robustness, and latent-compensation paths. A validation-calibrated router uses observable channel availability to allocate path contributions, preserving complete-channel discrimination while increasing representation recovery under severe missingness. In BNCI2014-001, TriRouter outperforms standard public backbones and a dynamic-spatial-filtering corrupted-EEG baseline. It improves accuracy over the strongest corrupted-EEG baseline by 3.68, 4.02, and 6.46 percentage points at nominal 25%, 50%, and 75% missing settings, and remains effective under structured regional missingness and additional low-channel dataset evaluation.

item.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models.

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models. However, training agents over long-horizon interactions presents two challenges: using only terminal rewards makes turn-level credit assignment sparse and high-variance, while sequential mini-batch updates on a fixed rollout batch introduce policy staleness as the current policy drifts from the behavior policy. Existing approaches obtain denser credit via learned critics, process reward models, or on-policy distillation, but they rely on a value network, step-level annotations, or a stronger external teacher that increase training complexity. Meanwhile, importance sampling and clipping mitigate policy drift, but they do not specify a finite target that stops sequential updates from overshooting. In this work, we introduce TreeOPSD, a critic-free, tree-aware posterior self-distillation framework for long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning. Treating each interaction turn as a tree node, TreeOPSD branches alternative continuations from shared prefixes and recursively backs up terminal rewards into implicit turn-level credit. It then maps each credit to a closed-fo…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：循环语言模型用同一组物理 Transformer block 跨逻辑深度重复用，但 recurrence 位置、输入注入、循环状态组织常被混在一起——把这些轴拆开后哪一组合最优？

方法：在匹配参数/逻辑深度/token 预算下从零训练循环 Transformer，把 recurrence 位置、输入注入与循环状态组织三项正交化系统研究；优选 prelude-recurrent block-coda 三明治架构 + Huginn 风格设计，并迁移到 active-parameter 匹配的 MoE 模型。

关键数字：730M/336B token 规模下 Huginn 完整架构在 10 个基准上均优于 Ouro；优势迁移到 MoE：8B(32B unroll)/500B token 下知识/推理/编码基准近全胜；同 FLOPs 下常驻参数比 112 层 FF MoE 基线少 75%，DROP/GSM8K 仍优于基线，MATH500 持平。

为什么值得看：把循环模型设计从"各种变体"还原为可独立研究的三轴并给出 Huginn 风格的最优配方，做循环/重用参数模型的可参照蓝本。

原文：Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design

item.title: TileDRAM: Compiler-Controlled Tile-to-DRAM Layouts for 3D DRAM GPGPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：现代 GPU 编译器有 thread/on-chip 的丰富 layout 抽象，但 CU-local 3D DRAM 上没有 tile→DRAM 布局抽象；常规放置会让结构化 tile 访问撞到 row-buffer 冲突。

方法：TileDRAM 把 GPU Linear Layout 从计算侧映射扩展到 DRAM 放置坐标，按每个 tile 访问签名选 layout，以行缓冲行为单位评估候选；运行时仅做普通地址算术，无需新硬件或 ISA。

关键数字：在 Accel-Sim/Ramulator2 上 108 个 MoE FFN 用例的 full-trace replay：按请求加权的行冲突率从 75.7% 降至 15.2%，几何均速 1.77x；6 条 trace 在 6 种 3D DRAM 组织上几何均速 2.20x；RTX 3090 上地址变换可承受。

为什么值得看：把 GPU layout 抽象延伸到 3D DRAM 放置坐标，让编译器就能显著降冲突，做 GPU 编译器/3D DRAM 的桥梁工作。

原文：TileDRAM: Compiler-Controlled Tile-to-DRAM Layouts for 3D DRAM GPGPUs

item.title: The Sign Code: The Hidden Binary Nature of Deep Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size).

Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size). We call the set of all neuron signs the \textit{sign code}. This raises a key question: does classification depend more on the sign code or on the magnitudes? For overparameterized vision classifiers with sign-preserving activations, the answer is overwhelmingly the sign code. A $k$-nearest neighbor classifier operating only on this binary sign code achieves accuracy comparable to the full model across different architectures, activation functions, and datasets. Moreover, replacing all magnitudes in every layer with random noise while keeping the original signs barely changes residual network performance. In contrast, flipping just 20\% of the signs reduces accuracy to chance. Models generalize well when same-class inputs share similar sign codes. When this overlap is disrupted by a regularizer, training accuracy remains high, but test performance collapses. A margin decomposition helps explain these results: the sign-only contribution to each logit grows as $\sqrt{d}$ in network width, dominating the magnitude residual. The natural unit o…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TALLOP: Joint Optimization of Local Training and Communication Compression for Time-Constrained Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：联邦学习里慢客户端拖累整轮时间；既有工作主要调本地计算，通信受限环境下通信压缩同样会成为瓶颈——如何在一个时间预算内联合调本地训练与通信压缩？

方法：TALLOP 用早期 mini-batch 损失轨迹预测不同计算预算可达训练损失（LENS），用压缩误差模型估计通信压缩损失（CLEN），二者组合求每轮时间预算下的最优本地训练工作量与通信压缩配比。

关键数字：在异构联邦环境下较仅调计算或仅调压缩的基线，达到目标精度所需墙钟时间更短（具体加速比详见原文图表）。

为什么值得看：把联邦学习的时间预算问题变成可联合优化的两个独立预测器，工程上可直接套用到联邦训练调度器。

原文：TALLOP: Joint Optimization of Local Training and Communication Compression for Time-Constrained Federated Learning

item.title: SigmaTrace: Library-Agnostic Observability for CPU/GPU-Initiated RDMA Communication
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 RDMA 已被广泛采用，可观测性却缺失：现有工具要么绑定特定通信库、要么只报聚合数据，缺逐操作视角；缺口最大的是 GPU-initiated 网络，其 kernel 内 RDMA 操作对主机完全不可见。

方法 提出库无关的 RDMA 剖析框架 SigmaTrace，在 libibverbs/mlx5dv 层（InfiniBand 与 RoCE 通信库之下的公共分母）追踪操作，并用低开销内存插桩实现——据作者所知，这是无需源码打补丁或二进制插桩即可观测 GPU-initiated RDMA 的首次尝试。

关键数字 主机侧追踪在 128 GPU 的 NCCL AllReduce 上开销 1.3%，1024 GPU 的 RCCL 上低于 2%；在常驻 kernel 的 BFS 与 MoE 推理上暴露出 in-kernel barrier 扩散和 2.13 倍的节点间流量倾斜，现有 profiler 看不到。

为什么值得看 把"GPU 发起的通信"从黑盒拉回可观测范围，是定位大规模训练通信瓶颈的直接工具型贡献。

阅读原文

item.title: SETAREH Transform: A Sorting-Assisted Haar-Wavelet Sparsification Method for Approximate Inner-Product Computation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：深度学习中高维输入/参数向量反复存储、传输、计算；模型压缩做得多，但输入向量本身的存储/通信开销仍是边缘/分布式部署的痛点。

方法：SETAREH 用 Haar 小波稀疏化：对固定系数向量与相继输入向量做相同置换 + Haar 变换，截断前保留精确内积；保留部分变换后的系数-输入对以减表示开销，引入可控近似误差。

关键数字：在合成高斯基线与 APPA-REAL 真实年龄估计任务上，用显著更少的非零项逼近被评估的内积（具体倍数详见原文图表）。

为什么值得看：把"输入向量通信开销"从模型压缩的盲区拎出来，给边缘/分布式推理一个可调近似内积机制。

原文：SETAREH Transform: A Sorting-Assisted Haar-Wavelet Sparsification Method for Approximate Inner-Product Computation

item.title: Response-Informed Value Estimation for Cost-Aware Multi-Turn LLM Routing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Multi-turn LLM routing selects a model at every turn before its response is available, yet task success is revealed only when the interaction ends, leaving each intermediate choice without a label of its own.

Multi-turn LLM routing selects a model at every turn before its response is available, yet task success is revealed only when the interaction ends, leaving each intermediate choice without a label of its own. Logged trajectories, however, retain the response each call produced, which exposes what each turn required and how well the chosen model served it, evidence that outcomes alone hide. We introduce RIVET (Response-Informed Value Estimation for Turn-Level Routing), which exploits this post-call evidence during training while keeping routing strictly pre-call at deployment. RIVET jointly trains two value estimators over a shared state-model representation: a deployable Routing Value Estimator that scores candidate models from pre-call information, and a training-only Response-Informed Value Estimator that additionally observes the realized response. Conditioning on the response turns response-induced return variation from residual noise into an observed covariate, and we show that this reduces the leading asymptotic estimation error of the shared representation. On the MINT benchmark, RIVET solves more held-out tasks than the strongest multi-turn baseline while using 74.7% less t…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: QuarkShard: Decomposing Cross-Shard Requests into Single-Input Transactions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：分片区块链处理跨片用户请求时，传统"整体事务"范式同时带来片内 BFT 开销与片间通信开销——能否把跨片请求拆开降低两类开销？

方法：QuarkShard 把跨片请求分解为只需单分片共识与处理的"单输入分片事务"，并设计分解算法保证资金原子性或位置原子性；还通过结构特性增强抗 MEV/洪泛攻击能力。

关键数字：跨 4 个 AWS 区域的广域网评估峰值吞吐 1024k 请求/秒、时延 <4 秒；较传统分片协议吞吐提升最高 210.7%（具体基线对比见原文）。

为什么值得看：把跨片交易从"原子单体"解构为单输入事务，性能与安全性同时改善，分片链协议设计的新基线。

原文：QuarkShard: Decomposing Cross-Shard Requests into Single-Input Transactions

item.title: Predicting CVSS and CWE from CVE Descriptions with Fine-Tuned Small Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Until April 2026, the National Vulnerability Database labeled nearly every published Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entry with a Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) v3.1 v

Until April 2026, the National Vulnerability Database labeled nearly every published Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entry with a Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) v3.1 vector, a severity tier, and a Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) weakness type. Now, NIST enriches only the high priority CVEs, leaving many newly published vulnerabilities unlabelled with the classifiers that security teams use for patch triage. In CVE enrichment, we predict the eight base components of CVSS v3.1 vector, base score, severity tier, and CWE from the vulnerability's textual description alone. To prevent leakage between near-duplicate descriptions, all systems are trained only on CVEs published in 2022 and 2023. Results are evaluated on all 36,325 usable 2024 CVEs in the pinned NVD snapshot. All scores are either directly predicted, or calculated from predicted vectors using the CVSS formula. A fine-tuned 3.8B-parameter model Phi-3.5-mini, trained with LoRA in 2.5 hours on a single Apple M5 Pro chip, achieves 69.9% accuracy on severity and 70.9% on CWE. It matches the official vector exactly for 48.8% of test CVEs, outperforming TF-IDF logistic regression by 2.8 to 4.7 points on all…

item.title: Predictable Scaling: Efficient Model Exploration via Scaling-Law Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Evaluating candidate changes (hypotheses) to recommendation models requires full-scale training runs consuming thousands of GPU-hours, severely limiting the hypothesis space engineers can feasibly explore.

Evaluating candidate changes (hypotheses) to recommendation models requires full-scale training runs consuming thousands of GPU-hours, severely limiting the hypothesis space engineers can feasibly explore. We introduce Predictable Scaling (PS), a systematic framework that exploits empirically verified regularity conditions to predict full-scale model performance from small-scale proxies. PS constructs scaled-down variants via composable scaling functions along distinct resource axes, and projects metrics to the target scale via curve fitting with calibrated uncertainty estimates. We compare three prediction strategies of increasing expressiveness: even the simplest (raw proxy) achieves prediction error within the empirical noise floor of repeated-run variance; the most expressive (Gaussian Process) provides an indicative 15% relative MAE improvement and calibrated uncertainty. Evaluation on two ranking models of increasing complexity---a task-specific model and a foundation model---demonstrates that PS correctly ranks actionable hypotheses across diverse hypothesis types at 79-88% compute reductions.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Ori: Drift-Aware Streaming $k$-PCA for Very Low-Rank LLM Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

A prominent family of low-rank LLM optimizers, pioneered by GaLore, performs gradient-subspace projection: at each step, they project the gradient into a low-dimensional subspace and map the update back to the full model.

A prominent family of low-rank LLM optimizers, pioneered by GaLore, performs gradient-subspace projection: at each step, they project the gradient into a low-dimensional subspace and map the update back to the full model. Most existing work either recomputes the gradient subspace at certain intervals, or performs post-hoc adaptation to catch up to the moving subspace. In this work, we explicitly identify in practice the slow, stable manner in which LLM gradient subspaces drift across time. To this end, we propose Ori, a novel low-rank optimizer for training LLMs that captures the shifting principal gradient directions over time to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy under stringent low-rank constraints. Ori employs a streaming $k$-PCA algorithm inspired by Oja++, whose low per-step cost enables high-frequency, on-the-fly subspace tracking. In practice, Ori reduces the performance gap of the state-of-the-art low-rank optimizers to full-rank optimizers by up to 69.3\% on a 1B LLaMA pretraining task, and achieves the best performance on 10 out of 16 task scenarios in Roberta-Base fine-tuning. Together, these contributions allow Ori to further push the performance and efficiency frontier…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: One Communicator, Three Vendors: Extending the MoA Predictive Theory to a Real NVIDIA+AMD+CPU MPI Ensemble
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：将 MoA（Multiple of an Algorithm）预测理论扩展到首个真正的多厂商 MPI 通信器时，1/t 权重切分的假设在哪种硬件上会失效？

方法：用 Slurm 异构作业把 A100/MI100/CPU 共 9 个 rank 装入一个 MPI communicator；给出三路并发 1/t 权重切分理论与异构作业的可接受指令；用基于形状的 key/value 切分做 ring Allreduce，对每次测量记录提前预测。

关键数字：MI100 上 6 rows 实测 597 ms，1/t 线性预测仅 1.6 ms；通过改 launch 设置把 ~600 ms 降至 14.6 ms，6 rows 下每调用能耗降 32x；MI100 仍约比 A100 在 8192 rows 下慢 95x；8.5 MB Allreduce 实测 11.3/16.0/15.3 ms。

为什么值得看：揭示了 MoA 1/t 假设在 GPU 上的失效边界，并把异构 MPI 实测与理论预测摆在一起，异构 HPC 通信建模可直接借鉴。

原文：One Communicator, Three Vendors: Extending the MoA Predictive Theory to a Real NVIDIA+AMD+CPU MPI Ensemble

item.title: On the Power of Alternating Local Certification with Constant-Size Certificates
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

We study alternation hierarchies for distributed decision in anonymous networks with constant-size certificates.

We study alternation hierarchies for distributed decision in anonymous networks with constant-size certificates. A prover and a disprover alternately assign certificates to nodes over a constant number of rounds, after which each node decides whether to accept based on its own input and the certificates observed in its neighborhood. An instance is accepted if all nodes accept. Unlike previous work on distributed alternation hierarchies, which considered restricted local computation (Reiter, PODC 2024) or logarithmic-size certificates (Feuilloley et al., ICALP 2016), we focus on constant-size certificates and the role of neighborhood information in determining expressive power. We consider three models: SET, where nodes observe only the set of certificate sequences of their neighbors; MULTISET, where multiplicities are also visible; and PORTS, where neighbors can additionally be distinguished by local port numbers. We establish that SET is strictly weaker than MULTISET, which is in turn strictly weaker than PORTS, and that all three alternation hierarchies are strict at every level. Despite their severe restrictions, these models are remarkably expressive: LEADER belongs to the thir…

item.title: Next Token or Vector? Learning How Far to Decode
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Standard autoregressive decoding advances one token at a time, even when several upcoming tokens can be predicted together.

Standard autoregressive decoding advances one token at a time, even when several upcoming tokens can be predicted together. We propose CADENCE (Context-Adaptive DEcoding), a generation method that learns both what to draft and how far to draft. Gaussian prediction heads represent future spans as continuous latent vectors, and a shared decoder converts the selected vector into token predictions in parallel. A learned router selects the prediction length from the model's own hidden states and predicted Gaussian parameters, adapting generation granularity to the current context with single-token generation as a fallback. The backbone verifies each proposed continuation and retains the prefix that matches its greedy predictions. Experiments with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on Alpaca, GSM8K, and HumanEval show that router-selected positions yield higher draft acceptance than applying the corresponding prediction length everywhere. CADENCE achieves up to 1.3x higher generation throughput than standard greedy decoding.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

关键数字：最高 1 petaflop 的 FP4 AI 算力、最高 128GB 统一内存；可在轻薄本上渲染 90GB+ 的 3D 场景、以 1440p 超 100 帧玩 3A 游戏。

item.title: Muon Operates Beyond the Edge of Stability
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

We study the Muon optimizer using sharpness and provide the first empirical evidence that the Flat Minima Hypothesis also applies to Muon. Further, we derive Muon's implicit preconditioner t

We study the Muon optimizer using sharpness and provide the first empirical evidence that the Flat Minima Hypothesis also applies to Muon. Further, we derive Muon's implicit preconditioner to analyze its potential Edge of Stability behavior. Experiments on CIFAR-10 show sharpness strongly correlates with generalization gap within each optimizer (Pearson $r = 0.45$-$0.69$, $p \leq 10^{-4}$), confirming the hypothesis holds for Muon similarly to Adam and SGD. However, Muon operates above the classical sharpness-based Adaptive Edge of Stability threshold that bounds diagonally-preconditioned optimizers like Adam and RMSprop, yet remains stable. Our findings suggest Muon operates in a fundamentally different regime than diagonally-adaptive methods. Defining the exact stability boundary for Muon remains an open question. All code is available at this https URL.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Morpheus-2.0: Multiscale Probabilistic Forecasting with Dual-Axis Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

A universal forecaster is trained once and applied everywhere, so it must serve tasks whose schemas, forecast horizons, and temporal resolutions all differ. The number of targets and covaria

A universal forecaster is trained once and applied everywhere, so it must serve tasks whose schemas, forecast horizons, and temporal resolutions all differ. The number of targets and covariates changes from dataset to dataset, horizons vary by orders of magnitude, and sampling rates range from seconds to years. Existing time-series foundation models address these only in part, since they isolate each series or visit the two grid relations in separate blocks, and they fix the horizon and resolution before training begins. We introduce Morpheus-2.0, a compact encoder-only foundation model that represents targets and covariates on a single variable-time grid. Its dual-axis attention runs both relations side by side in every layer, one across variables at a timestep and one across time within a variable; a learned gate weights the two per layer, and an axis-aware rotary encoding preserves both grid coordinates. The forecast length is sampled during training, so one set of weights spans short to long horizons at no additional inference cost. Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale extends the model to several temporal resolutions at once, weighting them according to the series being forecast. Across GI…

item.title: Merge Hulls Without Copying Vertices: GPU Isotonic Regression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Isotonic regression finds the monotone sequence closest to the data in weighted least squares. It is used to calibrate probabilities and inside differentiable ranking.

Isotonic regression finds the monotone sequence closest to the data in weighted least squares. It is used to calibrate probabilities and inside differentiable ranking. Its standard algorithm, pool adjacent violators, is sequential within a sequence, and torchsort, the exact GPU solver of differentiable sorting libraries, runs it with one thread per sequence, which is slow on long ones. The fit is the slope sequence of the lower convex hull of cumulative sums, and hulls of sorted points can be merged in parallel. Merging partial hulls level by level, however, copies the surviving vertices at every level, which moves $\Theta(n \log n)$ data when most points survive. We store each chunk's hull once and represent a merged hull as a list of segments of these chunk hulls, at most one per chunk; a merge then updates the list. We prove the representation correct, bound the work and depth of the merge phase, and measure a CUDA implementation on four NVIDIA GPUs against a control that copies the surviving vertices with the whole GPU at every level. On dense hulls the merge phase is 17 to 276 times faster with segment lists and the whole operator 3.9 to 19 times; on noisy data, where few vert…

item.title: MailRail: Mitigating Incast Congestion with User-Space, Node-Based Flow Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Irregular workloads, such as those stemming from Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, frequently induce severe incast congestion in large-scale parallel environments.

Irregular workloads, such as those stemming from Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, frequently induce severe incast congestion in large-scale parallel environments. Existing fabric-level congestion control mechanisms rely on reactive, link-level rate limiting that degrades overall throughput. While receiver-driven, credit-based flow control offers a proactive alternative, as process counts scale memory slots per rank fall below usable thresholds, rendering traditional rank-based accounting untenable. To address this challenge, we introduce MailRail, an out-of-order, asynchronous messaging framework, along with a novel user-space, node-based credit flow control system. item.title: MAC units for a 2x2 int8 systolic array on Tiny Tapeout
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.AR　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

We take the multiply-accumulate (MAC) unit of an open-source 2$\times$2 int8 systolic array taped out on Tiny Tapeout (GF180 process) and propose two replacements. The first one, \emph{hybri

We take the multiply-accumulate (MAC) unit of an open-source 2$\times$2 int8 systolic array taped out on Tiny Tapeout (GF180 process) and propose two replacements. The first one, \emph{hybrid}, uses a different arithmetic structure for each row of the array. It reduces the logic area of one MAC unit by 4--6\% and of the whole chip by 0.7--3.2\% after place and route. The second one, \emph{fused\_eq}, never builds the long carry chain of the accumulation. It shortens the critical path by 20\% for one MAC unit and by 14\% for the whole chip. All numbers come from the standard Tiny Tapeout flow (LibreLane) run in GitHub Actions. Correctness is checked by exhaustive simulation of all $2^{24}$ inputs, a formal equivalence proof, and the original test bench.

item.title: Looped GNNs Beyond Fixed Depth: Graph Size Generalization and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Generalizing from small graphs to larger ones can require computation beyond the depth of a neural model used during training. We study target tasks that admit a common local iterative compu

Generalizing from small graphs to larger ones can require computation beyond the depth of a neural model used during training. We study target tasks that admit a common local iterative computation and whose effective dependency radius grows with graph size. The central idea is to learn a local update rule through GNN pretraining, then repeatedly apply the same learned processor beyond the training depth to extend information reach on larger graphs without retraining. Calling such parameter-shared architecture a \emph{looped GNN}, we categorize six schemes for looped GNNs to separate the effects of depth extension, fine-tuning, and freeze-and-steer adaptation. Our analysis establishes fixed-depth information limits and sufficient conditions under which accurate iterative reuse overcomes them. To improve beyond unadapted reuse, we introduce \emph{Loop-Freeze-Steer} (LFS), which freezes the pretrained processor and learns a small controller to steer its repeated application, using much fewer trainable parameters than full fine-tuning. Our finite-sample analysis gives sufficient conditions for adaptation to improve performance on larger graphs. Experiments on synthetic tasks and chip p…

item.title: Logic-Guided Graph Denoising Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Graph diffusion models are competitive approaches for generating complex graph-structured data.

Graph diffusion models are competitive approaches for generating complex graph-structured data. However, when such distributions have strict structural constraints, diffusion models may fail to capture them exactly, resulting in the generation of invalid graphs. In this paper, we propose a method for grounding graph diffusion models in domain-specific knowledge via First Order Logic (FOL), leveraging its expressive and interpretable formalism to impose structural constraints on the generative process. We incorporate domain knowledge using classifier guidance, a technique that conditions the diffusion model's distribution on external variables to exert control over the sampled data. During the generative process, classifier guidance steers the denoising trajectory to optimize an objective function, which we define as a fuzzy and differentiable relaxation of the logical rules. Our methodology requires only the specification of constraints in FOL, whose satisfaction is encouraged at inference time to guide a pre-trained generative model. We evaluate our approach by comparing the unconditional generation of knowledge graphs with our logic-guided framework, which incorporates domain ont…

item.title: Local proxies for memory-efficient training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：端到端反向传播要存所有激活，显存爆炸；现有 local learning 又常掉精度——能否在保持精度的同时把"全局反向"近似为块级局部代理？

方法：对每个 Transformer 块训练一个局部代理网络以蒸馏逼近全局网络输出；用代理独立反传来估计梯度；理论上对深度线性网络是精确的，对非线性残差模型梯度误差可被残差代理界定。

关键数字：CIFAR-100 + ViT 上代理传播相对其它 local 算法取得更优的精度/显存权衡；在小显存预算下微调 LLM 时比同等显存开销的零阶学习方法训练更快、性能更高。

为什么值得看：把"局部学习"从启发式变成"有理论保证的梯度近似"，小显存训练 LLM 的可选新底座。

item.title: Large Diffusion Models Need More Than EMA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Large-scale diffusion models are commonly trained with a constant learning rate (LR) and exponential moving average (EMA), despite the strong performance of LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization in training large language models.

Large-scale diffusion models are commonly trained with a constant learning rate (LR) and exponential moving average (EMA), despite the strong performance of LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization in training large language models. We study whether EMA is uniquely suited to diffusion training, or whether stronger alternatives have been underexplored. Our theory shows that averaging a constant-step trajectory has an inherent optimization limitation, whereas LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization admit vanishing stationarity guarantees under standard nonconvex assumptions. Empirically, LR decay and EMA provide complementary benefits: combining decay with EMA further improves the standard baseline at most tested starting points, although the gain remains sensitive to when decay begins. Schedule-Free avoids this timing requirement and consistently outperforms EMA with a constant LR across training stages, achieving both lower fixed-evaluation objectives and better generation quality. Our analysis further shows that all three strategies substantially reduce parameter variability, yet stronger stabilization is not always better: EMA with a constant LR retains comparatively higher parame…

item.title: LangNCO: Compiling Natural-Language Constraints into Inference-Time Interventions for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) rapidly produces high-quality solutions for problem structures encountered during training, but operational requirements may change after deployment and be communicated in natural language.

Neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) rapidly produces high-quality solutions for problem structures encountered during training, but operational requirements may change after deployment and be communicated in natural language. We propose LangNCO, a framework that compiles instance-specific requirements into structured inference-time interventions for a frozen NCO solver, without changing the pretrained policy's architecture, learned input representation, or parameters. A pretrained LLM serves as a replaceable semantic front end, translating each requirement into a schema-validated domain-specific language (DSL) rule set. A deterministic Rule Executor applies the rules as nonexpansive hard action masks. Because local masking prevents immediate violations but does not ensure that a complete feasible continuation remains reachable, Critical-Offset Decoding extracts rule-referenced critical nodes and reallocates part of a fixed rollout budget to multi-strength biased rollouts. Using controlled task-specific language to isolate solver adaptation from open-ended language robustness, we evaluate a CVRP policy on road closures, time windows, vehicle assignments, visit-order requirements…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, enabling non-autoregressive text generation through parallel decoding.

Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, enabling non-autoregressive text generation through parallel decoding. Existing dLLMs can be broadly categorized into two families: masked diffusion models (MDMs) and uniform diffusion models (UDMs) In this work, we theoretically show that MDMs are easier to optimize due to their mask-based transition schedule but have lower computational expressivity, whereas UDMs enable iterative state revision and greater expressivity but are substantially harder to train. This trade-off raises a natural question: can we obtain the expressivity of iterative revision without giving up the simple, easy-to-optimize transition schedule of MDMs? Motivated by this analysis, we propose Lookahead Editing (\ours{}), which augments masked diffusion decoding with a rewritable proposal state. At each decoding step, the model performs several lookahead updates to iteratively refine future predictions in this proposal state before committing tokens to the masked sequence. item.title: KVCompass: A Discovery Plane for Internet-Scale Prefix Cache Sharing in LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.DC　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

KV cache reuse is one of the most effective ways to reduce LLM inference cost, but today its benefits are largely confined to a single cluster. When a provider serves the same model across g

KV cache reuse is one of the most effective ways to reduce LLM inference cost, but today its benefits are largely confined to a single cluster. When a provider serves the same model across geographically distributed regions, each region may repeatedly prefill the same popular prefixes, wasting GPU time and increasing time-to-first-token (TTFT). Exploiting reuse across regions involves discovering which worker currently holds a reusable KV cache for each request's prefix. We show that this KV cache discovery problem is structurally harder than conventional object lookup. Unlike hash-placement mechanisms such as DHTs, where an object's location is a deterministic function of its key, KV caches are created on the workers that serve requests, and their holder sets change with subsequent requests and KV cache evictions. KV cache discovery therefore calls for decoupling KV cache identity from placement. We present KVCompass, a discovery plane for Internet-scale KV cache sharing. item.title: JAXtari: High-Throughput and Easy-to-Modify Arcade Learning Environment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) has been a cornerstone of Deep Reinforcement Learning research, providing a standardized benchmark for evaluating general agents.

The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) has been a cornerstone of Deep Reinforcement Learning research, providing a standardized benchmark for evaluating general agents. However, its lack of native support for object-extraction and environment modification restricts research into evaluating whether agents learn robust causal models or rely on brittle visual heuristics. Furthermore, the ALE's dependence on CPU-based emulation creates a significant bottleneck in modern GPU-accelerated training pipelines, limiting both experimental scale and iteration frequency. In this work, we introduce JAXtari, an open-source, high-performance reimplementation of Atari 2600 environments. By leveraging massive GPU parallelization, JAXtari allows PPO agents to finish training on 100M environment steps on a single A100-GPU in under an hour. Beyond speed, it provides object-centric observations and a flexible modification system, allowing researchers to, e.g. develop neuro-symbolic methods or discover novel shortcuts and subsequently train and adapt their agents rapidly, sometimes in only minutes.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Inside the Loop: A Mechanistic Study of Weight-Tied Transformers on Depth-Bound Algorithmic Tasks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Solving algorithmic tasks with many sequential steps typically requires scaling up transformer depth or chain-of-thought length, incurring unfavorable parameter and inference-compute costs,

Solving algorithmic tasks with many sequential steps typically requires scaling up transformer depth or chain-of-thought length, incurring unfavorable parameter and inference-compute costs, respectively. Looped transformers, which reuse one block of layers across many iterations, are poised to address this, since they scale effective depth without adding parameters or tokens. Yet, it remains unclear what each iteration is actually computing, or whether the loop merely simulates a deeper untied stack. Here, we study directed permutation traversal, in which a model follows $H$ hops from a starting node and reports the node it reaches, so every intermediate hop has a known ground truth. We find that a minimum effective depth is necessary to solve the task, beyond which the degree of weight tying becomes the determining factor. For instance, a looped transformer with a four-layer block iterated eight times solves the task in every seed, while an identically-trained untied transformer of the same effective depth never does, succeeding only with a lower learning rate or supervision of its intermediate layers. Probing and intervening on the residual stream, we find that the looped model a…

item.title: Information Estimation with Discrete Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Information-theoretic measures, such as Mutual Information (MI), play a crucial role in understanding non-linear relationships between random variables and are widely used across scientific disciplines.

Information-theoretic measures, such as Mutual Information (MI), play a crucial role in understanding non-linear relationships between random variables and are widely used across scientific disciplines. Yet, their use on real-world discrete data remains challenging. Existing methods typically rely on embedding discrete data into a continuous space and apply neural estimators originally designed for continuous distributions. This process requires careful engineering for both the embedding model and estimator architecture, but suffers from issues related to high data dimensionality. In this work, we introduce InfoSEDD, a discrete diffusion-based approach that bridges information-theoretic estimation and generative modeling such that they can be used to compute Kullback-Leibler divergences. Backed by Continuous Time Markov Chains theory principles, the design of InfoSEDD is lightweight and scalable and allows seamless integration with pretrained models. We showcase the versatility of our approach through applications on motif discovery in genetic promoter data, semantic-aware model selection in text summarization, and entropy estimation in Ising models. Information-theoretic measures, such as Mutual Information (MI), play a crucial role in understanding non-linear relationships between random variables and are widely used across scientific disciplines. Yet, their use on real-world discrete data remains challenging. Existing methods typically rely on embedding discrete data into a continuous space and apply neural estimators originally designed for continuous distributions. This process requires careful engineering for both the embedding model and estimator architecture, but suffers from issues related to high data dimensionality. In this work, we introduce InfoSEDD, a discrete diffusion-based approach that bridges information-theoretic estimation and generative modeling such that they can be used to compute Kullback-Leibler divergences. Backed by Continuous Time Markov Chains theory principles, the design of InfoSEDD is lightweight and scalable and allows seamless integration with pretrained models. We showcase the versatility of our approach through applications on motif discovery in genetic promoter data, semantic-aware model selection in text summarization, and entropy estimation in Ising models. item.title: Inducing Fourier Geometry: A Smoothness Prior Imposes Approximate Translation Equivariance in Multimodal Stellar Embeddings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv/cs.LG　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

Learned representations often contain geometric structure induced by symmetries in the underlying data. We ask whether a known continuous parameter space can instead be used to \emph{induce}

Learned representations often contain geometric structure induced by symmetries in the underlying data. We ask whether a known continuous parameter space can instead be used to \emph{induce} such structure when the corresponding symmetry is only approximate. We introduce a graph-Laplacian smoothness prior that encourages representations to vary smoothly over a physical parameter space without specifying a representation geometry; in the continuum limit it selects Laplacian eigenfunctions and therefore predicts the Fourier-like geometry associated with translation symmetry. On multimodal stellar representations spanning six astronomical surveys, the prior induces Toeplitz Gram structure and sinusoidal modes along stellar parameters, including in modalities whose native representations lack this geometry, while modality-specific residuals preserve structure outside the imposed coordinates. item.title: HBFSim: A Simulator for Exploring HBF in Memory Hierarchies for LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：高带宽闪存（HBF）号称 TB 级加速器本地容量与接近 HBM 的带宽，但 NAND 的高延迟、异地更新与写入寿命又会直接影响性能与寿命——能否在系统层量化这些影响？

方法：HBFSim 是 LLM 感知的异构 HBM+HBF 内存系统事件驱动模拟器，联合 HBM、带 host-managed FTL 的 HBF 与常规容量层，以校准的 serving 前端驱动模拟；保留应用级内存语义同时建模闪存内部行为。

关键数字：在 Llama-3.1-70B 与 Qwen3-235B-A22B 三种负载上，HBF 较 host DRAM 快 11.0–19.0x 提供超 HBM 数据；HBM 更适合放运行序列的 KV 而非作为 HBF 的缓存；Llama-3.1-70B 在发布峰值负载下 HBF 寿命 2.0–6.9 年。

为什么值得看：把 HBF 这个新兴存储层级从规格表变成可量化的系统权衡，做 LLM 内存层级选型可以直接拿来用。

原文：HBFSim: A Simulator for Exploring HBF in Memory Hierarchies for LLMs

item.title: GUMPIM: Unitary and Malleable Memory for Processing-in-Memory with Guaranteed PIM Pages
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：DRAM PIM 受内存交织与虚拟内存限制，可用 PIM 粒度受限；强行隔离 PIM 内存又会让 CPU 内存带宽下跌、引入额外数据搬运——如何兼得？

方法：GUMPIM 用统一可塑内存空间允许交织 CPU 页与非交织 PIM 页共存，带"保证 PIM 页"分配；提出双轨内存管理 + PIM DRAM 动态地址映射硬件 + PIM 辅助页迁移；无需改动商用 DRAM 标准，硬件修改只局限在 PIM-enabled DRAM。

关键数字：保持了 CPU 内存带宽，PIM 任务 offload 几乎零拷贝（具体基准数字详见原文图表）。

为什么值得看：把"PIM 内存隔离损失"与"PIM 内存墙"两难命题一起解决，做 PIM 系统/硬件的人必读。

原文：GUMPIM: Unitary and Malleable Memory for Processing-in-Memory with Guaranteed PIM Pages

item.title: GR-OPD: Group-Relative Sequence Credit for On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback.

On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback. We introduce \method{} (Group-Relative On-Policy Distillation), which decouples feedback computation from credit assignment by aggregating token feedback into calibrated sequence-level credit. We establish a theoretical basis for this approach by showing that, under ideal on-policy assumptions, broadcasting raw summed feedback to every response token yields an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the sequence-level reverse-KL objective. To support effective learning in practice, \method{} discounts later feedback that may become less reliable under distribution shift and uses same-prompt rollout groups to calibrate teacher guidance. It preserves relative response preferences while retaining a controlled fraction of the group mean, which we term collective teacher pressure. Across five Qwen3 teacher--student settings and six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, \method{} outperforms vanilla OPD in macro Avg@K in every setting, including gains of 10.9 and 11.5 percentage points in two settings…

item.title: Forecasting Voltage Time Series under Anomalies Using a WGAN Model With Lipschitz Control and Progressive Kernel Critic Strategy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF

In time-series forecasting tasks, the use of recursive forecasting on high-dimensional data substantially increases the complexity of the prediction process.

In time-series forecasting tasks, the use of recursive forecasting on high-dimensional data substantially increases the complexity of the prediction process. The main challenge is that long-term dynamics becomes harder to model, since the sequences show greater temporal variability. To counteract this limitation and improve the modeling of long-term dynamics, and more importantly, address high-dimensional recursive forecasting, this paper uses a Wasserstein GAN equipped with a progressive Lipschitz penalty and an adaptive kernel. This model is capable of taking a window of the data stream and forecasting the next values, subsequently reconstructing the time-series stream and dynamically adapting its kernel to each new window. The proposed model is a deep learning framework based on a Wasserstein GAN (WGAN-CLP) with an adaptive kernel to model alterations in streaming voltage time series. To establish the methodological foundation, we review the WGAN-LP formulation another variant model in this class and extend its framework through an adaptive kernel critic model. We then evaluate this extended model using power ratios, correlation coefficient (CC), and relative root mean squared e…

item.title: Flash RNN-T: Memory-Efficient Joint Network and Transducer Loss Computation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-16　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：流式 ASR 主流仍是 RNN-T，但训练需要存大中间张量，显存吃紧——能否在保持吞吐的前提下大幅压低显存？

方法：Flash RNN-T 用专门 kernel 做联合网络与 transducer 损失，支持可选的按对齐空间与词表的 tiled 重计算；不 tiled 与 tiled 两个变体覆盖吞吐-显存前沿。

关键数字：H100 上，untiled Flash 相对最快基线吞吐提升 24–39%、显存下降 26–56%（适用时）；tiled Flash 中等长度上显存降至 1/9（吞吐低 16%），长序列下在 80 GB 显存中其他方案均无法用单反向 batch 跑通。

为什么值得看：把流式 ASR 训练的显存-吞吐前沿完整刻画，做端侧/长流式语音训练的人可直接对照配置。

原文：Flash RNN-T: Memory-Efficient Joint Network and Transducer Loss Computation
